economy.zh:
**经济板块综述**

过去24小时，全球金融市场再度遭遇来自中国AI领域的冲击波。月之暗面（Moonshot AI）发布Kimi K3模型，性能逼近美国顶级AI实验室，引发市场对中美AI竞争格局的重新评估，被媒体称为“第二次DeepSeek时刻”。该消息叠加白宫宣布管制前沿AI模型访问权限、中东局势升温及芯片股抛售，导致美股周五收跌，欧洲科技股承压。与此同时，中国经济呈现结构性分化：Shein通过港交所聆讯但估值减半，茅台逆势涨价，而美国恢复香港贸易优惠待遇则为市场注入一丝暖意。

- [中国AI模型Kimi K3震撼硅谷](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/moonshot-ai-kimi-k3-model-openai-anthropic-china.html) —— 月之暗面推出的开源权重模型在多项基准上接近Claude和GPT，加剧了市场对AI算力需求可能分流的担忧，直接拖累美股芯片板块，英伟达CEO旧夹克拍出近百万美元成为另类注脚。
- [白宫控制前沿AI模型访问权限](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/white-house-ai-access-anthropic-openai.html) —— 特朗普政府开始决定谁可获取最先进AI模型，这一行政干预或将重塑AI产业权力结构，与中国的开源策略形成鲜明对比。
- [中东局势推升能源股](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/iran-war-oil-tanker-strait-hormuz-traffic-attacks-trump.html) —— 伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡附近袭击油轮致船员死亡，原油价格飙升，欧洲能源股逆势上涨，但避险情绪压低整体市场。
- [Shein通过港交所上市聆讯](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3360940/shein-passes-hearing-hong-kong-listing-valuation-halves-below-us50b-sources-say) —— 快时尚巨头估值从此前约1000亿美元腰斩至不足500亿，但仍有望成为今年香港最大IPO，反映一级市场估值调整趋势。
- [美国恢复香港优惠贸易待遇](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNLTlXckM5RURyUDhoa1hpQlFLYVBRRXhPc3p1bk5zN1pYajNVZ3dNeTdZZ3laSjNJZndNcEpIbEwxQnl2S2ZabndtTm83N0pUb3oxaVpsRWJPbTJNN0NGWUtYclJ0RFl1Q1lVcXB0V3dBbEpFZ3RtdzNSUUhOMnZ0R1JLTEFYSURucnRNakZURi1RUG9XUk5HeE9KM0tfQ0xNVEVGX2RUMWJfdkgwdWNqUFJ3) —— 香港制裁到期未续，中国商务部表示赞赏，此举或缓解中美贸易紧张，但长期博弈仍存变数。
- [飞天茅台再涨价](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5TTG95bWt2RXhmcXFweUR3VTV6dGhzMFU5SFoxbUUyS081Y1lfRTEzeTZuclpzQm5nbkVjUDZ2S2UzZW5zV2lxVGNYbkdBRVBxalBNdlFDbFVXZDFiV0FZOFlR) —— 贵州茅台上调i茅台平台零售价及合同价，在消费疲软背景下释放高端白酒定价权信号。

**后续观察：** 中国AI开源模型的快速迭代将持续冲击全球科技资产定价逻辑，下周ECB利率决议及美国PMI数据将成为市场焦点。需密切关注霍尔木兹海峡局势对原油供应链的进一步影响，以及Shein上市定价能否为港股IPO市场带来信心。
economy.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a resurgent Chinese AI sector, escalating geopolitical frictions, and deteriorating consumer sentiment in the US. A new open-weight model from Moonshot AI—dubbed the 'second DeepSeek shock'—has rattled global tech valuations, while the White House moves to assert control over frontier AI model access. Meanwhile, CNBC's All-America Economic Survey shows the public increasingly blaming President Trump for a worsening economic outlook. In Europe, the tech selloff spilled over ahead of next week's ECB decision, and Middle East tensions pushed energy stocks higher. China's markets fell alongside weaker trade data, but the Shein IPO cleared a key HKEX hearing and Airbus secured a major order from Chinese airlines. The US also let Hong Kong sanctions expire, a move Beijing welcomed.

- **AI Arms Race Intensifies**: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 model has caught up to US frontier labs, triggering a global tech selloff as markets weighed the implications of open-weight models. [Read more](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/moonshot-ai-kimi-k3-model-openai-anthropic-china.html) | [Fortune](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE9UV0dRVi1ER1ZhME1RMDQ5SkxlckFEZE83RXFBRkRWZnpaVXMtY2htN01SVlcxOHU1blh6UDloTnp2b3JhbXZMc0hnTnlRZzlFUTQyLTRTMU5DZVFjSHBUS3F4d21yY0lCR09lNEtrcTM0NGtodzJHdHd5UQ)
- **White House Seeks to Control Frontier AI Access**: The Trump administration is dictating who gets access to the latest models from labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, shifting power dynamics. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/white-house-ai-access-anthropic-openai.html)
- **US Economic Sentiment Tumbles**: CNBC's All-America survey shows public depression on par with post-pandemic years, with blame squarely on the White House. [Survey details](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/economic-outlook-is-worsening-and-trump-is-getting-blamed-cnbc-survey-finds.html)
- **Tech Selloff Broadens**: Wall Street ended lower for both day and week as semiconductor stocks slid; SpaceX fell below IPO price after postponing a launch. [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/spacex-postponed-a-crucial-launch-now-its-stock-is-set-to-slide-even-further-below-the-ipo-price-143adfe0?mod=mw_rss_topstories) | [Virginia Business](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE0zSFpTdk5pdDhWaFJLZTc0cW1VbVRyc0x1ejJ2THBMTVVVSkVDUi1rbG8zOTRmVDFuRjdWXzdJSWJrSkVPdlNCQkQwaUhvRGtCc3B6TEo4dVFfalk0LXYzZE1pcHpFSmR4UVdWRmwzSHBvbWExa01BTS0xSHc)
- **Geopolitical Flashpoints**: Iran attacks oil tanker off Oman, raising 'worst case scenario' for Hormuz; Trump threatens pollution tariffs on Canada over wildfire smoke. [CNBC on Iran](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/iran-war-oil-tanker-strait-hormuz-traffic-attacks-trump.html) | [Canada tariffs](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/trump-canada-wildfire-tariffs.html)
- **China Markets Under Pressure**: Hong Kong and Shanghai fell on worse import-export data, but capital migration from South Korea's bear market is boosting Hong Kong tech stocks. [AsiaNews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPTUxCcGgzZTdaS19LWlo5RG1JZWREYlNuclFUem9JZ1BIeHNYOHRyTThQcFhGZVZzdFBTSG9ZTmVYM2lXa0hjTnFySTlJYTBlOVFZUkFYYzJQcVR1UEZwb3dXbTJrWWVQaFYzb0g4djZWdDA4eHdSVGoyd3hEQWdpc0ppNWhXUXRyWTdfYUtTcEJoZHExaWtodEJuV0pYUko3N0d2NXkzZXBkVzlMQ1BKNzhndmQwV28yV21qRkZB) | [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360904/south-koreas-turbulence-seen-boon-hong-kong-stocks-capital-migration-under-way)
- **Shein, Airbus, and Trade Deals**: Shein passed HKEX hearing with valuation halved to <$50B; Airbus sold 55 jets to Chinese airlines; US restored Hong Kong tariff privileges. society.zh:
过去24小时，全球社会新闻呈现冲突升级与自然灾难交叠的紧张态势：美伊战火燃至霍尔木兹海峡，全面战争一触即发；俄乌内部出现政治裂痕；北美山火引发贸易争端；墨西哥强震带来海啸警报；日本皇室改革与校园安全事件亦牵动民意。与此同时，人工智能全球治理成为中国主场外交的核心议题。

- 美伊冲突持续升级。美国连续第七夜轰炸伊朗，目标从军事设施扩展至桥梁，伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊宣布“谈判时代已结束”，[警告将升级为全面战争](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/18/iranian-official-says-the-policy-of-negotiating-during-war-is-over)。美军同时打击霍尔木兹海峡附近目标，[战略意图显著扩大](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/18/targets-of-latest-us-strikes-on-iran-signal-strategic-shift)。
- 乌克兰政局震荡。国防部长费多罗夫被解职引发士兵公开批评，[BBC报道前线士兵表达愤怒](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg8w4dpjkwo)，可能影响军队士气与作战能力。俄罗斯国内则继续打压异议，[反战批评者被罚款或拘押](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn0n3y6ewn4o)。
- 加拿大山火引发美加贸易摩擦。特朗普威胁对加拿大加征新关税，理由为山火烟雾“[污染美国城市](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyq93j34lgo)”。加总理卡尼回应称气候变化是共同责任，凸显气候议题的政治化。
- 墨西哥近海发生[7.3级地震](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjv3815yxo)，引发太平洋海啸警报，已记录0.3米波高，暂无重大伤亡报告。
- 菲律宾向中国提出外交抗议，因[中国日报视频被指种族主义描绘菲律宾人](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/18/manila-protests-racist-portrayal-of-filipinos-in-china-daily-videos)，南海紧张背景下此事件可能加剧双边关系波动。
- 日本通过皇室改革法案，公主婚后可保留皇族身份，[引发社会热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFA1dG1QUXh0alJWd05uR3VLX0JyYjVwcUxoWHk0WnZQX0RVMHZ3WlFGNWpPZ0Y0cC1fNkFjSm9xUWwyV0pMQkJzRGtnTTFiN0hwc2c0Z2wwdmh2aE9oZjV6dWJISkVtdGRLVWdB)。大阪一所初中发生[不明物质喷洒事件](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQTzJUU2ItVFdsTVdwOVI5YmtqdGpNRmtCa29ieWhWQnpITmxRVUVKY0lYcHJTcUpUX0JLdTZ0blF5MHc2a2R6MWMtMG5ueXZhU0tCbEtmaWw1VjVnaU84Sm1NT2xXV2VZNnNuTk0yZzdUNW5xcTFYX2FOdU5hNFUwVmRSZkZPTWNEeUtjcHlJdFd5cGc)，23人受伤，校园安全再敲警钟。

后续观察：美伊冲突若继续升级，将对全球能源供应与安全格局产生深远影响；俄乌内部矛盾可能改变战场态势；加拿大山火在气候变暖背景下或成常态性危机；中国在AI治理领域的主动作为则彰显其全球治理角色。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalating military conflict between the US and Iran, with strikes expanding to bridges and bases, and Tehran warning of full-scale war. Elsewhere, Russia intensifies domestic repression, Ukraine faces internal turmoil over a defense minister's removal, a major earthquake hits Mexico, and global markets show jitters. Social and cultural tensions also flare: the Philippines protests alleged racist portrayals, Canada-Trump trade dispute over wildfire smoke, and the EU signals a slower decarbonization pace. Below are the key developments.

- **US-Iran conflict escalates rapidly**: The US struck Iranian bridges for the seventh consecutive night, broadening targets to degrade Iran's military, while Iran retaliated by targeting US bases in the Gulf. An Iranian official declared the policy of negotiating during war is over, warning of full-scale escalation if bombing continues. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy748n8zx8ro), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/17/g-s1-134158/us-iran-war-updates), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/18/iranian-official-says-the-policy-of-negotiating-during-war-is-over?traffic_source=rss))
- **Russia clamps down on dissent**: A fine and a remand order target anti-war critics, including barring Boris Nadezhdin from running for parliament and detaining blogger Ilya Remeslo. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn0n3y6ewn4o))
- **Ukrainian soldiers outraged by defense minister removal**: Protests erupted after Mykhailo Fedorov's dismissal, with troops criticizing the move amid ongoing conflict. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg8w4dpjkwo))
- **Magnitude 7.3 earthquake off Mexico coast**: Tsunami waves up to 0.3m recorded in Puerto Madero and Chiapas; no major damage reported yet. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjv3815yxo))
- **Trump threatens new Canada tariffs over wildfire smoke**: Cites 'filthy' air from Canadian fires drifting into US cities; Canadian PM Carney calls for shared climate responsibility. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyq93j34lgo))
- **EU proposes slowing carbon emission cuts for businesses**: Relaxation of the emissions trading system to give companies more time, signaling a policy shift amid economic pressures. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckgv0zd497zo))
- **Manila protests 'racist' China Daily videos**: Depiction of Filipinos as monkeys amid South China Sea tensions sparks diplomatic row. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/18/manila-protests-racist-portrayal-of-filipinos-in-china-daily-videos?traffic_source=rss))
- **Somali pirates hijack second tanker in three months off Yemen**: Multiple unsuccessful attacks signal resurgence of piracy in the region. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c7vg6dml34vo))

**Watch next:** Expect further escalation in US-Iran hostilities as both sides expand target sets; the humanitarian toll of the Mexico earthquake will become clearer in the coming hours. Markets in Japan and South Korea are in panic mode, and the EU's emissions policy shift could trigger debate among member states. The Philippines-China spat over media portrayal may strain regional diplomacy.

military.zh:
## 军事新闻简报：2026-07-18

过去24小时，全球军事格局呈现多点爆发态势。**美伊冲突**在霍尔木兹海峡进入实质交火阶段，美军重启封锁并击伤油轮，航运量骤降，油价应声上涨；与此同时，美国空军紧急增派加油机与战斗机，并提升隐形巡航导弹与反舰导弹产能，显示出应对双线作战的紧迫感。**高超音速武器**领域出现重大进展与挑战并存：美军“朱姆沃尔特”号完成改装即将重返舰队，但GAO报告指出海陆军缺乏统一战略，且洛克希德·马丁公司量产能力不足。**中国军情**方面，南海仲裁案十周年之际，北京加大主权声索动作，并与俄罗斯深化军事合作；澳大利亚与瓦努阿图签署协议阻止中国建军事基地。此外，俄乌战争新阶段、教皇呼吁恢复粮食协议等议题也值得关注。

- **美伊互袭基础设施，海湾航运风险飙升**：美军与伊朗连续六晚互相打击目标，美军宣称击中数十处伊朗军事设施，社交媒体视频显示伊朗南部桥梁被毁。美军在重启伊朗港口封锁次日即用“地狱火”导弹击伤试图靠近的油轮，导致霍尔木兹海峡通行量骤降，油价周线走高。参见 [U.S.-Iran Fight Heats Up With Mutual Strikes On Infrastructure Targets](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-iran-fight-heats-up-with-mutual-strikes-on-infrastructure-targets) 和 [Strait of Hormuz traffic plunges as US-Iran tensions rekindle shipping fears](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPQm9obVM1SU1hZVUzeVNGWmJIWHd5aDZLQldFdE9GREttNFBmTmFyRTg1UFl5MVFJZVJ2ZXhteXNsR2Vsdy1ybEFyVWd0VU95VEJRX2FvV0I0QjlESHdpTDJETm1mamZMRkJvMnJaZ0ZfZC1ZYm92bzNIX3ctSTJjRFRyZkFzZi1qVmJpZUg0RFUxS1NEQlhwU3pCYnBydzNfYWNRVE5tOTRYbk9JZzM2VmNZZ0R5QQ)。
- **美空军大幅扩充隐形打击弹药**：为应对中国海军威胁，美空军将AGM-158系列导弹（JASSM/LRASM）的采购量从16,710枚增至23,095枚，增幅达38%。此举凸显对远程隐身穿透打击能力的迫切需求。详见 [U.S. Air Force Increases Stealthy Cruise, Anti-ship Missile Production](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/u-s-air-force-increases-stealthy-cruise-anti-ship-missile-production)。
- **“朱姆沃尔特”号完成高超音速改装，但海陆军战略脱节**：经过漫长升级，“朱姆沃尔特”号驱逐舰即将重返舰队，配备高超音速导弹发射能力。但GAO报告指出，海军进度落后两年，且陆海军之间缺乏统一的装备发展战略，导致资源浪费。参见 [USS Zumwalt Set To Return To Fleet After Long Anticipated Hypersonic Missile Upgrade](https://www.twz.com/sea/uss-zumwalt-set-to-return-to-fleet-after-long-anticipated-hypersonic-missile-upgrade) 和 [Navy, Army risk wasting money, time without unified hypersonic missile strategy: GAO](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/navy-army-risk-wasting-money-time-without-unified-hypersonic-missile-strategy-gao/)。
- **南海博弈加剧：中俄合作、澳瓦协定、媒体争议**：中国国防部呼吁各方理性看待中俄军事合作，而澳大利亚与瓦努阿图签署协议阻止中国建立军事基地。南海仲裁十周年之际，北京动作频频，包括官媒AI视频将菲律宾人描绘成猴子引发外交纠纷。参见 [澳大利亚和瓦努阿图签署协定，阻止中国建立军事基地](https://news.google.)。
- **AI重塑战争形态，教皇呼吁恢复粮食协议**：韩国媒体评论指出AI已改变战争方程式，俄乌冲突与中东冲突中AI的应用正在加速。同时，教皇方济各呼吁俄罗斯恢复黑海粮食协议，但进展不明。参见 [“See what happened in Ukraine and the Middle East?”... AI has changed the war equation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5UeEt1MU9QSk9mUUdDYjZIUHVOVHlTZ21ObnBkQmp2YlJETmJySmc2cXJzTlJ3Q056TUNwcXV0VE9NbjdDcGo4N05nZW1BNGEtX3dR) 和 [Pope appeals to ‘my Russian brothers’ to restore grain agreement](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQcmNqd3F1NTNKcXRvckNUZDA0SVQ3VTZVTUtGdHJyWVR5eUhRdUI5blg2WEVoNDZPQ0d4RmUwTXNjb1lIdmllQktTaHJkb0NVa016cG9UWnVBVHdCV3FyUGo5dW03WmRqUTlGRGp3NDJhZzB5U2dSNjY1TXp3UmtDUTl0dUdQVkVITGlRZ1lvU3FXVXNxUkNBYTc4eU9vQVk)。

**后续观察**：霍尔木兹海峡的封锁与反封锁可能成为短期最大风险爆发点，油价与全球供应链面临直接冲击。美军同时应对中东与印太两线，装备采购与部署节奏持续加速，但GAO报告揭示的协调问题可能制约实际战斗力形成。南海方向，中国在仲裁十周年之际强化主权声索，与周边国家的摩擦可能升级，需关注东盟国家反应。俄乌战场虽未出现重大变化，但AI技术的渗透值得长期跟踪。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in U.S.-Iran hostilities, with mutual infrastructure strikes and a renewed blockade severely disrupting Strait of Hormuz traffic. Concurrently, a new GAO report reveals major delays and cost overruns in the U.S. hypersonic missile program, while China's military assertiveness in the South China Sea and Indo-Pacific continues to draw countermeasures from regional partners. AI is emerging as a new flashpoint in information warfare.

- **U.S.-Iran strikes escalate**: The sixth consecutive night of U.S. strikes in Iran targeted bridges and military infrastructure, while Iran retaliated. A U.S. blockade of Iranian ports led to a tanker being disabled by Hellfire missiles. [Strait of Hormuz traffic has plunged](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPQm9obVM1SU1hZVUzeVNGWmJIWHd5aDZLQldFdE9GREttNFBmTmFyRTg1UFl5MVFJZVJ2ZXhteXNsR2Vsdy1ybEFyVWd0VU95VEJRX2FvV0I0QjlESHdpTDJETm1mamZMRkJvMnJaZ0ZfZC1ZYm92bzNIX3ctSTJjRFRyZkFzZi1qVmJpZUg0RFUxS1NEQlhwU3pCYnBydzNfYWNRVE5tOTRYbk9JZzM2VmNZZ0R5QQ) as risk appetite evaporates. [Mutual strikes](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-iran-fight-heats-up-with-mutual-strikes-on-infrastructure-targets) have pushed oil prices to a weekly gain.
- **Hypersonic missile program in trouble**: The GAO found the Navy is two years behind schedule on installing hypersonic missiles on Zumwalt-class destroyers, with Lockheed Martin struggling to scale production. [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/navy-army-risk-wasting-money-time-without-unified-hypersonic-missile-strategy-gao/) reports a lack of unified strategy may waste billions. Meanwhile, the USS Zumwalt is finally set to return to fleet after a long upgrade. [TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/uss-zumwalt-set-to-return-to-fleet-after-long-anticipated-hypersonic-missile-upgrade)
- **Air Force ramps up missile production**: The U.S. Air Force is expanding procurement of stealthy cruise and anti-ship missiles (JASSM/LRASM) from 16,710 to 23,095 units to counter China's naval threat. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/u-s-air-force-increases-stealthy-cruise-anti-ship-missile-production)
- **Australia unveils fake Chinese tank**: The Australian Army displayed an Abrams tank disguised as a PLA Type 99 to enhance realism in exercises against its primary adversary. [TWZ](https://www.twz.com/land/australian-army-unveils-abrams-disguised-as-chinese-tank)
- **China’s SLBM launch**: France confirms it had advance notice of China’s submarine-launched ballistic missile test, viewed as a demonstration of nuclear deterrence. [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/interviews/2026/07/france-advance-notice-china-slbm-launch/)
- **AI propaganda war**: Chinese state media used AI-generated video depicting Filipinos as monkeys, prompting condemnation from Manila. [RFI](https://news.google.)

**Watch next**: The dual shipping lane threats in the Middle East could further destabilize global oil markets. The U.S. hypersonic missile timeline will be scrutinized in upcoming congressional hearings. China’s response to Australia-Vanuatu base denial and continued South China Sea patrols will shape regional dynamics.

tech.zh: 今日科技板块信号密集：**AWS账单故障**导致客户收到数十亿美元账单，云服务可靠性再遭质疑；**苹果与谷歌**被旧金山检察官勒令下架“脱衣”App，监管利剑直指应用商店审核漏洞；**TP-Link摄像头**被曝六年来通过未认证UDP泄露家庭GPS，IoT安全老问题再添新案例。AI领域，**美国考虑设立类似FINRA的监管机构**审查前沿模型，而**Kaiser护士**公开抗议AI监控影响护理质量，AI落地医疗的伦理冲突升级。汽车方面，**德国BEV销量首次超越燃油车**，标志性转折；**丰田**推出3000美元换购补贴抢夺二手EV市场。HackNews社区则因**Isomorphic Labs药物设计引擎**和**静态搜索树论文**引发热议。以下为分板块详解。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is dominated by a cascade of regulatory, market, and infrastructure signals. From AI governance tightening to a fresh wave of cloud billing errors and autonomous vehicle recalls, the ecosystem is recalibrating around trust, transparency, and safety. Meanwhile, consumer electronics face a memory crunch driven by AI demand, and the automotive world sees record EV adoption in Germany alongside aggressive expansion by Tesla and BYD. The hacker community buzzes with open-source tools and a critical IoT vulnerability disclosure.

- **AI governance heats up:** The US is reportedly considering a FINRA-like watchdog to vet top AI models ([Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-17/us-considers-creating-finra-like-watchdog-to-vet-top-ai-models)), while Kaiser nurses rally against AI-driven workplace surveillance ([localnewsmatters.org](https://localnewsmatters.org/2026/07/15/kaiser-nurses-say-ai-workplace-surveillance-are-making-their-jobs-and-patient-care-worse/)). Alphabet's stock dips amid AI researcher departures ([Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBDcktQcUJfMGViRGlpMmg4SGJocFZ5STA4TTZZZ3BVdVVkeFJtbzZ2MEFzRGhlcDFiNzl0dUtvUlhBbnVSOWdzQnRHMFpNN0VQVHg2QjlFN0tkcDFJVWhFWkhlaFFvLXZlMkQtRHJLaHBfSkJmUU9LdDAzVnlUZw)).
- **Massive AWS billing glitch:** An error in Amazon Web Services' billing system inflated some customers' monthly charges from cents to billions of dollars ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/amazon-web-services-glitch-oh-no/)), exposing fragility in cloud cost controls.
- **Apple and Google ordered to purge 'nudify' apps:** San Francisco's city attorney demands removal of apps that create non-consensual nude images, citing long-standing state law violations ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/apple-and-google-ordered-to-purge-nudify-apps-from-app-stores/)).
- **Zoox recalls robotaxis over smoke confusion:** A software recall addresses the NHTSA's push for better emergency responses in autonomous vehicles after smoke from wildfires disrupts perception systems ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217803/zoox-issues-software-recall-because-its-robotaxis-may-be-confused-by-smoke/)).
- **AI-driven memory crunch hits India's smartphone market:** The AI boom is reshaping supply chains and pricing, slowing smartphone sales in India as memory demand spikes ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/ai-driven-memory-crunch-jolts-indias-smartphone-market/)).
- **Tesla expands into Latvia and Uruguay, Germany sees EVs outsell gas cars:** Tesla opens two new markets ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/tesla-latvia-uruguay-launch/)) while battery EVs hit record share in Germany ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/in-the-birthplace-of-the-automobile-electric-cars-are-now-king/)).
- **TP-Link Kasa cameras leaked GPS for 6 years:** Unauthenticated UDP broadcasts exposed home locations; a vulnerability disclosure with 60 points on Hacker News underscores IoT privacy risks ([GitHub](https://github.com/BadChemical/IoT-Vulnerability-Research-Public/blob/main/TP-Link_Kasa_EC71/Kasa_EC71.md)).
- **FAA lets Boeing self-certify 737 MAX and 787 again:** The agency restores Boeing's authority to sign off on airworthiness certificates, a major step in regulatory trust rebuilding ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/faa-boeing-737-max-787.html)).

**Watch next:** The interplay between AI model regulation and corporate moves—such as Meta's potential multibillion-dollar data center deal with Anthropic ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217904/meta-is-reportedly-considering-a-multibillion-dollar-data-center-deal-with-anthropic/)) and Databricks' $188B valuation ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/databricks-hits-188b-valuation-extending-its-run-as-ais-favorite-second-act/))—will shape the next phase of AI infrastructure. On the consumer side, the Pebble smartwatch's short warranty debate ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/967471/pebble-smartwatch-warranty-repairs-migicovsky-interview)) and the Apple TV price hike question ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2212812/is-apple-tv-4k-worth-after-price-hike/)) signal shifting expectations for hardware trust.

## 体育新闻日报

今日体育版图由世界杯激荡余波、羽坛超级冷门与虎扑社区的热议共同塑造。英格兰半决赛负于阿根廷后，图赫尔与哈里·凯恩的战术角色遭多方炮轰，甚至引来特朗普的跨界点评；西班牙则携团队自信静待决赛。羽毛球日本公开赛爆出惊人冷门：男单头号种子石宇奇遭逆转，女单世界前三（安洗莹、山口茜、陈雨菲）集体止步八强，王祉怡决胜局4-21溃败。虎扑社区里，LPL夏季赛BLG惨败DK引发对选手Bin的猛烈批评，巴萨寻找“小蜘蛛”替代者的传闻也热度飙升。NBA休赛期，詹姆斯再度强调乔丹与Jay Z的榜样作用。

- [Defiant Tuchel defends decisions and says loss is 'scar we carry now'](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3r0l4zn9jpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) ——图赫尔赛后发布会强硬回应战术质疑，称失利是“我们背负的伤疤”。
- [Argentina like to leave mark on opponents - Laporte](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj63e8l0kjjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) ——西班牙后卫拉波尔特在决赛前放话：阿根廷喜欢在对手身上留下“印记”。
- [国羽4胜3负收官，连爆大冷世界第1第2第3都止步8强：石宇奇被逆转](https://news.google.) ——日本羽毛球公开赛一日之内连续掀翻世界前三，男单石宇奇出局尤为令人震惊。
- [【虎扑JRs之声】热议#DK战胜BLG#](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1yODROVjI0UGRTTE5HZTZFV0d2WnM0b2s0RUh5V3JfcGd6XzYwY1Jod1ZTYV83UDhJeWJvV3o2TlNtLU51YUt5YjcyWXBXcU90ZVdid0c4OVVIdy1DVFgzcGFCOA) ——虎扑用户激烈抨击BLG上单Bin“巨婴心态”，认为其贪功冒进拖累全队。
- [Villa sign Newcastle target Manzambi in club-record deal](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13564492/johan-manzambi-aston-villa-sign-newcastle-target-from-freiburg-in-club-record-59-5m-deal) ——阿斯顿维拉以创队史纪录的5950万英镑从弗赖堡签下中场曼赞比，截胡纽卡斯尔。
- [詹姆斯：乔丹是我篮球方面的榜样，Jay Z就像大哥是生活榜样](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBJU2h0Y2hTRWVYdWhzQ2M3cnhLRzVvUHlyeGhZRlJNUEVrWGcwOFNacEM4TWxLUHlsSF82Z1M1aGFwNER0NWRqdjNqTVJMUmtDS0tUWC1R) ——勒布朗·詹姆斯在最新访谈中分享偶像观，将乔丹与Jay Z分别定义。

**后续观察**：世界杯决赛西班牙 vs 阿根廷将在周日打响，双方均完成大名单磨合，西甲球员占比近半，战术博弈值得关注。羽毛球日本公开赛进入半决赛日，国羽能否在女双、混双项目挽回颜面，将决定本次征战的最终评价。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours in sports have been dominated by the fallout from England's World Cup semi-final defeat to Argentina, the build-up to Sunday's final between Spain and Argentina, a series of stunning upsets at the Japan Open badminton tournament, and lively debate on Chinese sports community Hupu. England manager Thomas Tuchel faced intense scrutiny over his tactics, with even US President Donald Trump weighing in, while Spain's camp exudes quiet confidence. In badminton, top seeds including Shi Yuqi were eliminated, and the Hupu community buzzed with reaction to esports clashes and transfer rumors. Below are the key developments.

- **England's semi-final agony and Tuchel's defiant defense**: Thomas Tuchel called the loss a 'scar we carry now' after his tactical decisions were questioned. Former star Wayne Rooney urged the FA to stick with Tuchel unless Pep Guardiola is available. [Read more](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3r0l4zn9jpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Trump criticizes Harry Kane's role**: Donald Trump joined the chorus, asking why Kane was used in a 'defensive' role in the second half—an unusual political intervention that adds a layer of global attention to England's tactics. [Read more](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cjej3y1jgdpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Spain's collective faith ahead of final**: Former captain Cesar Azpilicueta explained that trust in the system is driving Spain's calm preparation. Meanwhile, Aymeric Laporte (Spain defender) warned that Argentina 'like to leave a mark' on opponents, setting up a tense narrative for Sunday. [Spain story](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/czxedvre7ryo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) | [Laporte comments](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj63e8l0kjjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Badminton shocks at Japan Open**: China's national team finished 4-3 overall, but top seeds Shi Yuqi (men's singles) and Wang Zhiyi (women's singles) were eliminated. World No.1, No.2, and No.3 all fell in the quarter-finals—a seismic shift in the badminton landscape. [Details](https://news.google.)
- **Aston Villa smash club-record £59.5m deal**: Villa beat Newcastle to sign midfielder Johan Manzambi from Freiburg, signaling a major transfer push ahead of the new Premier League season. [Report](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13564492/johan-manzambi-aston-villa-sign-newcastle-target-from-freiburg-in-club-record-59-5m-deal)
- **Hupu community erupts over DK vs BLG and T1 vs HLE**: Chinese fans criticized BLG player Bin's 'selfish playstyle' after DK's victory, while T1's win over HLE sparked intense ratings and debate on Hupu. [Bin criticism](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1yODROVjI0UGRTTE5HZTZFV0d2WnM0b2s0RUh5V3JfcGd6XzYwY1Jod1ZTYV83UDhJeWJvV3o2TlNtLU51YUt5YjcyWXBXcU90ZVdid0c4OVVIdy1DVFgzcGFCOA) | [T1 rating](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9ob1JReGIwa3VNMGFiazcwSFJLTjU5YzdNLUtWOXJEVU1CcnRPRzZYRXM5TlJ0RDJmVnBPMjhvZ1J0NUlVc29LUDRxQ1ppbmtrdkxpS2tUYzQ3WTFzZ3lPZ1pXQQ)
- **LeBron James on role models**: In a rare personal reflection, James said Michael Jordan is his basketball idol and Jay-Z is his 'big brother' life mentor—a story that resonated across Chinese social media. [Read more](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBJU2h0Y2hTRWVYdWhzQ2M3cnhLRzVvUHlyeGhZRlJNUEVrWGcwOFNacEM4TWxLUHlsSF82Z1M1aGFwNER0NWRqdjNqTVJMUmtDS0tUWC1R)

**Watch next**: The World Cup final on Sunday between Spain and Argentina is the marquee event, but badminton semi-finals at the Japan Open and continued esports action will keep fans engaged. Transfer market moves—particularly Villa's record signing and Barcelona's striker search—will also develop in the coming days.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐版图被诺兰的《奥德赛》史诗阵容、布拉迪与保罗的戏剧性冲突、以及艾美奖的削减风波三线贯穿。韩剧《Agent Kim Reactivated》再创收视新高，而中国娱乐圈在送别与反思中走向分化。以下是编辑精选：

- 诺兰版《奥德赛》完整卡司揭晓，马特·达蒙领衔，从奥斯卡得主到饶舌歌手全员集结，被视作2026年最受期待的史诗巨制。[《The Odyssey》Cast Guide](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/the-odyssey-cast-characters-christopher-nolan/)
- 汤姆·布拉迪在Fanatics Fest上掌掴洛根·保罗，事件后两人分别发推互呛，但多家媒体指出很可能是一场WWE跨界宣传的剧本表演。[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/sports/news/tom-brady-slaps-logan-paul-fanatics-fest-fans-staged-1236815284/) vs. [The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/tom-brady-logan-paul-slap-fanatics-fest-wwe-promo-1236651395/)
- 艾美奖决定将五个主要创作与表演类别移出黄金档直播，DGA、WGA、SAG-AFTRA罕见联合抗议，认为此举“贬低”幕后贡献。[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/dga-wga-sag-aftra-reaction-emmys-cut-categories-telecast-1236997353/)
- Lorde公开谴责Spotify推出的AI“关于歌曲”功能，称音乐人不想要这种上下文，引发创作者与平台间新的信任危机。[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/lorde-calls-out-spotify-ai-about-the-song-feature-1236997350/)
- 韩剧《Agent Kim Reactivated》在进入收官两周时刷新年内周五收视纪录，显示动作偶像剧仍具强大吸睛力。[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855515wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-earns-its-highest-friday-ratings-yet)
- 世界杯决赛门票套餐拍出400万美元天价，包含场边和颁奖仪式入场权，折射出体育娱乐消费的两极分化。[The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/world-cup-final-tickets-metlife-stadium-spain-argentina-1236651276/)
- 中国娱乐圈一周内痛失五位演艺人士，邹市明被曝创业亏光2亿元，华谊兄弟三十年浮沉录引发行业集体怀旧与焦虑。[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTFBHZUttYmhGMmFLVk9IVkxKQmpNdkVjOGV3RmNPWXJ1VDl0Y3dWV3B2NW83RUxzYW9KUUpzYlBldm55R3g4Y2h1N1RXLVVNT3I0bkEwOHNFMC12b2YxWHN5RWhBSmJoZXJXUWc0ZmRLUWxFa045enc)

**后续观察：** 明日关注诺兰《奥德赛》首映口碑是否能匹配其豪华配置；艾美奖公会抗议是否导致委员会妥协；布拉迪与保罗的“真打还是演戏”悬念有望在周末持续发酵。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape this Thursday is dominated by the epic scope of Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey,' the death of beloved chef Dom Taylor, and industry-wide tensions over Emmy category cuts. In Asia, Korean dramas continue to break ratings records while Chinese entertainment grapples with a wave of celebrity business failures and privacy invasions. Social media platforms are buzzing with fan-driven micro-dramas, from idol birthday gifts to on-set controversies.

- **Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Reveals Its Mythic Complexity**: Two major outlets ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/the-odyssey-explained-timelines-monsters-greek-legend-1236813704/) and [The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/the-odyssey-cast-characters-christopher-nolan/)) offer deep dives into the film's jumbled timelines, monster roster, and star-studded cast (Matt Damon as Odysseus), signaling a cultural event likely to dominate box-office conversation for weeks.
- **Emmys Cut Five Categories, Guilds Push Back**: The Television Academy voted to remove two acting, two directing, and one writing category from the primetime telecast. The DGA, WGA, and SAG-AFTRA jointly condemned the move as devaluing key crafts ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/dga-wga-sag-aftra-reaction-emmys-cut-categories-telecast-1236997353/)). This conflict could reshape Emmy viewership and industry perception.
- **Tom Brady vs. Logan Paul: Staged or Real?** The slap heard 'round the internet at Fanatics Fest has split speculation—was it a WWE-style promo or genuine beef? Both [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/sports/news/tom-brady-slaps-logan-paul-fanatics-fest-fans-staged-1236815284/) and [The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/tom-brady-logan-paul-slap-fanatics-fest-wwe-promo-1236651395/) cover the incident, with the latter noting Brady had teased a WWE villain role earlier that day.
- **Priyanka Chopra Joins Rajamouli's 'Varanasi'**: First-look stills reveal Chopra as Mandakini in a film spanning thousands of years ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/varanasi-first-look-priyanka-chopra-rrr-director-film-1236997441/)). The pairing of an Indian star with the 'RRR' director signals major cross-cultural appeal.
- **Lorde Calls Out Spotify's AI Feature**: The singer publicly criticized Spotify's new 'About the Song' AI beta, saying “We don’t want this” ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/lorde-calls-out-spotify-ai-about-the-song-feature-1236997350/)). This adds to growing artist backlash against AI in music.
- **Chef Dom Taylor Dies at 44**: The 'Five Star Chef' winner's sudden passing shocked the culinary world, with his restaurant confirming a 'sudden passing' ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/chef-dom-taylor-dead-netflix-five-star-chef-winner-1236997413/)). Taylor was a rising star in London's food scene.
- **Chinese Entertainment Mourns Five Figures in One Week**: A reflective piece ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTFBHZUttYmhGMmFLVk9IVkxKQmpNdkVjOGV3RmNPWXJ1VDl0Y3dWV3B2NW83RUxzYW9KUUpzYlBldm55R3g4Y2h1N1RXLVVNT3I0bkEwOHNFMC12b2YxWHN5RWhBSmJoZXJXUWc0ZmRLUWxFa045enc)) notes the emotional toll as celebrity deaths become routine, while boxer Zou Shiming's business loss of 200 million yuan ([Sina News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQNDJzcldvN1p1Z2dFNWhFUVlCY3NyN1FQclhKTE1LdnhTdFlfUDA3dVc5RkcxRjFManJHV3NRZzlEaWRkd05VVl9paXRMUWVBb29oMnNCOGgzZmtoSDhyQzB5dU9iUW5NTzZBQi1kTnZkMGtzVEJlMXMwLWg1RFFZaTZMa3pkS1M4bTE1MVlyY1gtUUVBV2xXQw) highlights the risks of celebrity entrepreneurship.
- **Korean Drama 'Agent Kim Reactivated' Hits Friday High**: The SBS action drama achieved its best Friday rating yet ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855515wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-earns-its-highest-friday-ratings-yet)), a strong indicator for its final two weeks.

**Watch next**: The fallout from the Emmy category cuts, whether the Brady-Paul slap becomes a WWE storyline, and the box-office impact of 'The Odyssey' as marketing ramps up. On the Asian front, the final ratings for 'Agent Kim Reactivated' and the debut of Disney's live-action Tiana project (with Colman Domingo writing) will be key.

美股.zh:
**美股：AI冲击波叠加芯片抛售，三大指数周线收跌**

周五美股全线下挫，芯片板块领跌，标普500和纳指录得周线跌幅。触发因素有三：中国AI模型Kimi K3的超预期表现让投资者重新评估美国AI公司的护城河；白宫宣布将控制前沿AI模型访问权限，增加政策不确定性；SpaceX发射推迟导致其股价跌破IPO价。此外，CNBC全美经济调查显示公众对经济前景悲观程度为疫情以来之最，特朗普支持率承压。

- [中国AI模型Kimi K3令硅谷“发愁”](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/meet-kimi-k3-the-newest-chinese-ai-model-haunting-silicon-valley-755ed738) —— 开源模型逼近闭源水平，市场担忧英伟达等硬件需求可能因算法效率提升而降温。
- [白宫控制前沿AI模型获取](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/white-house-ai-access-anthropic-openai.html) —— 特朗普政府秘密决定谁可使用最先进模型，此举可能改变AI产业竞争格局。
- [SpaceX推迟关键发射，股价连续两日低于IPO价](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/spacex-postponed-a-crucial-launch-now-its-stock-is-set-to-slide-even-further-below-the-ipo-price-143adfe0) —— 市场对航天商业化的信心受挫，盘前再跌约4%。

本周科技股估值面临修正压力，关注下周特斯拉等财报能否扭转悲观情绪。
美股.en:
US equities closed lower for both the day and the week as a broad tech selloff, particularly in semiconductors, weighed on sentiment. The AI landscape shifted dramatically after Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 model closed the performance gap with US frontier labs, while the White House announced new controls on access to advanced models. Meanwhile, the CNBC All-America Economic Survey showed a sharp deterioration in public economic confidence, with Trump receiving the bulk of the blame.
- **Chip Selloff Intensifies:** Wall Street ended lower on semiconductor weakness; SpaceX stock dropped below its IPO price after a mission was aborted. [MarketWatch on SpaceX](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/spacex-postponed-a-crucial-launch-now-its-stock-is-set-to-slide-even-further-below-the-ipo-price-143adfe0?mod=mw_rss_topstories) | [Virginia Business](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE0zSFpTdk5pdDhWaFJLZTc0cW1VbVRyc0x1ejJ2THBMTVVVSkVDUi1rbG8zOTRmVDFuRjdWXzdJSWJrSkVPdlNCQkQwaUhvRGtCc3B6TEo4dVFfalk0LXYzZE1pcHpFSmR4UVdWRmwzSHBvbWExa01BTS0xSHc)
- **AI Model Shock:** The open-weight Kimi K3 model from China's Moonshot AI is 'haunting Silicon Valley', according to MarketWatch. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/moonshot-ai-kimi-k3-model-openai-anthropic-china.html) | [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/meet-kimi-k3-the-newest-chinese-ai-model-haunting-silicon-valley-755ed738?mod=mw_rss_topstories)
- **White House AI Access Controls:** The Trump administration is dictating who gets frontier AI models, shifting power away from tech giants. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/white-house-ai-access-anthropic-openai.html)
- **Economic Gloom:** CNBC's survey finds public depression about the economy at post-pandemic levels, with Trump getting the blame. [CNBC survey](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/economic-outlook-is-worsening-and-trump-is-getting-blamed-cnbc-survey-finds.html)
- **Geopolitical Risk:** Iran's attack on an oil tanker near Oman raises 'worst case scenario' for Hormuz; Taco Bell recovers from cyclosporiasis scare. [Iran](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/iran-war-oil-tanker-strait-hormuz-traffic-attacks-trump.html) | [Taco Bell](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/cyclosporiasis-outbreak-linked-to-taco-bell-may-not-have-major-impact.html)
**Signal:** The combination of AI disruption, White House intervention, and souring consumer sentiment suggests continued volatility for US equities, with the tech sector particularly exposed to policy and competitive shocks.

欧洲经济.zh:
**欧洲经济：科技抛售拖累大盘，ECB会议在即**

受美股芯片杀跌传导，欧洲科技板块跌幅居前，但能源股因中东局势推升油价而逆势走强。市场焦点转向7月23日ECB利率决议，目前定价显示加息25bp概率约60%。同时，英国钢铁国有化引发中国“强烈不满”，英国商业环境面临不确定性；欧洲ETF上半年净流入2575亿美元，显示资金仍在积极配置。

- [科技抛售拖累欧股，静待ECB会议](https://news.google.) —— 欧洲泛欧指数收跌，科技股承压，但油气股因油价飙升获支撑。
- [ECB利率决议前瞻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOUjBCMWNFTTBIUk5jWUNqY2k0UjNmSGlmcmxoTFNydWxwWVczd2U3eHUtbUxkUURMcVVpTGFJUHVsTnlvS2hxTjJ1NktINlhmLWZ6MHFNRmZHNXJNNExDcERVYmlkQ1lkOUF0cUdpQ2ZaZlJYbnU0OUVWY2FqV01oWkJjRjNxQjBFSmc) —— 市场预期ECB将加息25bp，但欧元区通胀数据仍为决策关键变量。
- [英国钢铁国有化激怒中国](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/17/british-steel-nationalisation-china-strongly-dissatisfied) —— 中国商务部称此举“严重打击中国企业投资信心”，可能影响中英经贸关系。

ECB若如期加息，将进一步压制欧洲经济复苏预期，但能源板块短期仍有上行空间。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets ended mixed as a global tech selloff weighed on shares ahead of next week's ECB rate decision. Energy stocks rose on a crude surge driven by escalating Middle East tensions. The ECB's Piero Cipollone spoke about the 'cooperative spirit' of the digital euro, while the nationalisation of British Steel drew sharp criticism from China.
- **Tech Weakness Beats European Stocks:** The tech selloff that hit Wall Street spread to Europe, with investors cautious ahead of the ECB meeting on July 23. [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQOGpMM3hiNFRxY0h6Z01MczdJZFJKdzd0c1JGR2ZxQUJFUEdQb0NwNDlKejRLdGVITV9wWDRkdGJ3VmdsWnpEMlJqN1BrbDFVTnM4UGg5eEZGQmNGRXNYVXJVR01iTFRuMmh0bVBNSEU3Y1BDUDJnWE4zOFVMczVnM1RySHlON1puSHUtaFZNanhmQ0l5cm5CWDJrQkxrNFFFLVExUkNMQXVEQQ) | [WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPalhpRkNXbVA3MFRUYTZ3NE5lOVA0UGZNNWlBaTJjMU9KOWthVXNfVU9ZSlpmMndCTlFJMnBOMW56Z1FXa05TVGNIVXhkQm9wUGhiNmxaOVJtXzE4eDNVZzdPU0lvVWw3M2R2SXJxUnFJMmJHbjBzZkVud1UwbFlOUlI2MmVOWktUT3BQRk01NmU1V0lLYnlaYXczdmxPNW1QbzRqbEJUVEZhRF9tcmYyWXE0N2pibzNwTElZMw)
- **Middle East Boosts Energy:** European energy shares rose as oil prices spiked on Iran's attacks near the Strait of Hormuz. [finance.biggo.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTFBvV1hGTzhveFhMUENDUHlRS1BhZE1SdTMzeU0zTkU3WUJJNUMwM011MVpKaHZNaUxRSjNLUlRuN3R4enJRdzFlcDY3bE5TWXdLU2kxOHJibWpEcml3dEZSLW1jQTl6LUZ6UXFxSzJFdnEtZUNnREE)
- **ECB in Focus:** The ECB rate decision on July 23 is the key event; Morningstar and others preview a potential hold or cautious move. [Morningstar](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOUjBCMWNFTTBIUk5jWUNqY2k0UjNmSGlmcmxoTFNydWxwWVczd2U3eHUtbUxkUURMcVVpTGFJUHVsTnlvS2hxTjJ1NktINlhmLWZ6MHFNRmZHNXJNNExDcERVYmlkQ1lkOUF0cUdpQ2ZaZlJYbnU0OUVWY2FqV01oWkJjRjNxQjBFSmc)
- **British Steel Nationalisation Draws China's Ire:** China's Ministry of Commerce expressed 'strong dissatisfaction' with the UK's move, warning it hurts Chinese investment confidence. [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/17/british-steel-nationalisation-china-strongly-dissatisfied)
- **European ETFs See Record Inflows:** ETFs domiciled in Europe saw net inflows of $257.5 billion in the first half of 2026, signaling strong investor demand for European-domiciled products. [The Corner](https://news.google.)
**Signal:** The ECB's decision next week will be critical: a dovish tone could relieve rate-sensitive sectors, but ongoing tech and geopolitical risks suggest continued caution across European equities.

中国经济.zh:
**中国经济：AI冲击与政策红利交织，港股受益于资金迁移**

中国AI模型Kimi K3不仅扰动美股，也让港股科技板块获得正反馈——投资者将韩国资金外逃视为利好，恒生科技指数自6月低点已反弹约10%。同时，美国恢复香港优惠贸易待遇、Shein通过港交所聆讯、中国与阿联酋打通二维码支付等消息，共同支撑市场情绪。但消费领域仍存隐忧，Lululemon在华同店销售放缓，瑜伽服市场竞争加剧。

- [Kimi K3引发“第二次DeepSeek冲击”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE9UV0dRVi1ER1ZhME1RMDQ5SkxlckFEZE83RXFBRkRWZnpaVXMtY2htN01SVlcxOHU1blh6UDloTnp2b3JhbXZMc0hnTnlRZzlFUTQyLTRTMU5DZVFjSHBUS3F4d21yY0lCR09lNEtrcTM0NGtodzJHdHd5UQ) —— 港股AI概念股受提振，但投资者需警惕估值泡沫。
- [香港办公市场两极分化](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360960/hong-kongs-office-market-central-booms-noncore-areas-struggle) —— 中环空置率下降，非核心区仍疲弱，反映企业收缩与资金向优质资产集中趋势。
- [中国与阿联酋打通二维码支付](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3360913/china-and-uae-cross-border-qr-payment-link-boost-global-yuan) —— 人民币国际化再进一步，但实际交易量短期影响有限。
- [Xpeng进军德国汽车心脏地带](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3361008/chinas-xpeng-plants-flag-germanys-auto-heartland-mona-l03-launch) —— 在慕尼黑发布Mona L03，中国电动车出海欧洲面临关税与品牌双重挑战。

中国AI开源模型的全球影响力正在重塑资产定价，而香港作为资金避风港的角色得到强化。关注下周中国LPR报价是否调降。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets fell on Friday as worse-than-expected import-export data and the global tech rout dragged indices lower, though Hong Kong tech stocks benefited from capital rotation out of South Korea. The AI sector dominated headlines with Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 model causing a 'second DeepSeek shock', while Shein cleared a key HKEX hearing and Airbus secured a major aircraft order. The US let Hong Kong preferential trade privileges expire, which Beijing welcomed.
- **Kimi K3 Sparks AI Shock:** The open-weight model from Moonshot AI has matched US frontier labs, raising questions about the future of the AI race and impacting global tech stocks. [Fortune](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE9UV0dRVi1ER1ZhME1RMDQ5SkxlckFEZE83RXFBRkRWZnpaVXMtY2htN01SVlcxOHU1blh6UDloTnp2b3JhbXZMc0hnTnlRZzlFUTQyLTRTMU5DZVFjSHBUS3F4d21yY0lCR09lNEtrcTM0NGtodzJHdHd5UQ) | [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/moonshot-ai-kimi-k3-model-openai-anthropic-china.html)
- **Hong Kong and Shanghai Fall on Weak Trade Data:** Import-export figures worsened, adding pressure to an already weak market. [AsiaNews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPTUxCcGgzZTdaS19LWlo5RG1JZWREYlNuclFUem9JZ1BIeHNYOHRyTThQcFhGZVZzdFBTSG9ZTmVYM2lXa0hjTnFySTlJYTBlOVFZUkFYYzJQcVR1UEZwb3dXbTJrWWVQaFYzb0g4djZWdDA4eHdSVGoyd3hEQWdpc0ppNWhXUXRyWTdfYUtTcEJoZHExaWtodEJuV0pYUko3N0d2NXkzZXBkVzlMQ1BKNzhndmQwV28yV21qRkZB)
- **Shein Clears HKEX Hearing:** The fast-fashion giant's valuation halved to below $50bn as it moves closer to a Hong Kong IPO. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3360940/shein-passes-hearing-hong-kong-listing-valuation-halves-below-us50b-sources-say)
- **Airbus Wins 55-Aircraft Order from Chinese Airlines:** The deal includes 15 A350 widebodies, bolstering the European planemaker's presence in China. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/economy/china-economy/article/3361001/airbus-sells-55-aircraft-including-15-widebody-a350s-2-chinese-airlines)
- **US Restores Hong Kong Trade Privileges:** The expiration of sanctions drew thanks from China, signaling a temporary détente. [Nikkei Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNLTlXckM5RURyUDhoa1hpQlFLYVBRRXhPc3p1bk5zN1pYajNVZ3dNeTdZZ3laSjNJZndNcEpIbEwxQnl2S2ZabndtTm83N0pUb3oxaVpsRWJPbTJNN0NGWUtYclJ0RFl1Q1lVcXB0V3dBbEpFZ3RtdzNSUUhOMnZ0R1JLTEFYSURucnRNakZURi1RUG9XUk5HeE9KM0tfQ0xNVEVGX2RUMWJfdkgwdWNqUFJ3)
**Signal:** The AI shock is the headline risk for Chinese tech, but the Shein IPO and Airbus order signal continued deal-making; watch for further capital inflows into Hong Kong from South Korea and the impact of weaker trade data on Q3 GDP.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
**同花顺社区：天价分手费刷屏，茅台涨价引热议**

社区昨日最炸裂的消息是一家半导体3倍大牛股公告近60亿元天价分手费，迅速登上热搜。投资者围绕实控人离婚是否涉及变相套现展开激烈讨论。同时，贵州茅台宣布上调i茅台平台飞天茅台零售价及合同价，社区内部分化明显——看多者认为定价权强化，看空者担忧需求能否支撑。此外，某科创板上市公司（688500）董事长被刑拘，社区用户集中挖掘该股潜在风险，提示注意退市风险。

- [近60亿元天价分手费，半导体3倍大牛股深夜公告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE84WHpCZHcxcDVXaTB4Smx0NnBFVXhOY1l1N29mZ25SMWZzZHE1TS1uaFZvUmdTVDJ1c09YbHJURTVEVWJTUkh6ZVJaSVJjalN2S0VQM3ItUUkwUWc1RUtRdkdB) —— 网友调侃“芯片没有爱情”，但更多讨论聚焦于减持通道的合规性。
- [飞天茅台再涨价](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5TTG95bWt2RXhmcXFweUR3VTV6dGhzMFU5SFoxbUUyS081Y1lfRTEzeTZuclpzQm5nbkVjUDZ2S2UzZW5zV2lxVGNYbkdBRVBxalBNdlFDbFVXZDFiV0FZOFlR) —— 贵州茅台在i茅台平台调价，社区“茅粉”与质疑派激辩，成交额显著放大。
- [688500，董事长被刑拘](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1BLWxXdXlwM1YzejJ2TTJRMTBzSjl1ZmcwM25XNlZqY3dmc0hkMGxLUWZxM1JoVGU0QVphN0t1d3VzYzBmWXVNMVVTbUtjdDlSNVdTXzNrWmZuaElwOXpud0hR) —— 社区热门标签“风险警示”，用户复盘该股此前信披瑕疵。
- [昨日ETF资金净流入TOP 10榜单出炉](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5pOUJsSE5HQ0JUdHVsTlZpTlBpZDdWZExIc0pmNjZEZU80bUdlNkdCNndFMjMwTk56c3dsVEI2M293ZTZQdVJHbTRWeElobWdReHpLdkxTcnJBaGpPQmc) —— 资金主要流向沪深300和半导体ETF，与AI主题契合。

社区情绪整体偏谨慎，散户对消息面反应敏感。天价分手费与董事长被刑拘加剧了对上市公司治理的担忧，茅台涨价成为观察消费信心的风向标。
同花顺社区动态.en:
The 同花顺 community was active with a major corporate divorce settlement, price hikes for Moutai, and ETF flow data. A semiconductor stock (3x gainer) announced a nearly 6 billion yuan divorce settlement, while Kweichow Moutai raised retail and contract prices for Feitian Moutai on the iMoutai platform. The community also tracked a chairman's detention, Samsung's foldable phone restructuring, and the weekly commodity price index.
- **半导体3倍大牛股天价分手费:** A semiconductor stock that tripled in value disclosed a nearly 6 billion yuan divorce settlement, shocking retail investors. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE84WHpCZHcxcDVXaTB4Smx0NnBFVXhOY1l1N29mZ25SMWZzZHE1TS1uaFZvUmdTVDJ1c09YbHJURTVEVWJTUkh6ZVJaSVJjalN2S0VQM3ItUUkwUWc1RUtRdkdB)
- **飞天茅台再涨价:** Kweichow Moutai raised both retail and contract prices for Feitian Moutai on the iMoutai platform, signaling strong demand. [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE44bUFLcktEdlBldHNHOGQ5d290NTUxaEJveGdZazB1RnBRc2pDYkhaeEpvRXY4TVhfN2tCQkI1TF9fQ2RfRVBuc0FaMklTZlBSTGtyRF85emRGLTd2UGc)
- **ETF资金净流入TOP 10:** The top 10 ETF net inflows for the previous day were published, indicating where retail money is flowing. [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5pOUJsSE5HQ0JUdHVsTlZpTlBpZDdWZExIc0pmNjZEZU80bUdlNkdCNndFMjMwTk56c3dsVEI2M293ZTZQdVJHbTRWeElobWdReHpLdkxTcnJBaGpPQmc)
- **688500董事长被刑拘:** Company with ticker 688500 disclosed that its chairman has been criminally detained, a classic governance risk. [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1BLWxXdXlwM1YzejJ2TTJRMTBzSjl1ZmcwM25XNlZqY3dmc0hkMGxLUWZxM1JoVGU0QVphN0t1d3VzYzBmWXVNMVVTbUtjdDlSNVdTXzNrWmZuaElwOXpud0hR)
- **大宗商品价格涨跌榜:** The 28th week commodity price index showed movements across major commodities. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9GX3hrUTZTUzlWczB6MF9Edzh0aURCRXRabmVscm91NHZVRzFMaWhVb3Ayd0E5b0VCbnQ2Y2ZvWmtTdW4yOGZGRlFYSnBhWkxBQnpjVlRnMUpPZFVDWW5xakxB)
**Signal:** Retail investor sentiment appears mixed—excitement over Moutai price hikes and ETF flows, but concerns over governance scandals and divorce-related equity overhangs could create volatility in specific names.

欧美.zh:
中东战火加剧，美伊攻防进入新阶段；乌克兰政治变故引发军心不稳；北美山火触发贸易报复；墨西哥强震与菲律宾外交风波同步发生。

- [US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy748n8zx8ro) — 美国打击范围扩大，伊朗[明确拒绝谈判](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/18/iranian-official-says-the-policy-of-negotiating-during-war-is-over)，霍尔木兹海峡安全堪忧。
- [Ukrainian soldiers outraged over defence minister removal](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg8w4dpjkwo) — 前线士兵批评决策，或削弱抗俄凝聚力。
- [Trump threatens Canada tariffs over wildfire smoke](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyq93j34lgo) — 气候问题被用作贸易武器，加方强调共同责任。
- [Manila protests China Daily videos](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/18/manila-protests-racist-portrayal-of-filipinos-in-china-daily-videos) — 种族主义描绘激化中菲南海矛盾。
- [Magnitude 7.3 earthquake off Mexico](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjv3815yxo) — 太平洋海啸警报已解除，但灾害响应能力受考验。

欧美社会在多重危机下呈现高波动性，地缘冲突与自然风险交织，需密切关注美伊走向对全球市场的连锁冲击。
欧美.en:
The US-Iran conflict dominates, with the seventh consecutive night of US strikes on Iranian infrastructure, including bridges, and Iranian retaliation against US bases in the Gulf. An Iranian official warned of full-scale war if bombing continues. Meanwhile, Russia is cracking down on anti-war activists, Ukraine faces internal dissent over the defense minister's removal, and a major earthquake struck off Mexico. Additional stories include Trump's tariff threat over Canadian wildfire smoke, the EU's proposal to slow carbon cuts, and a Falklands banner controversy involving Argentina.

- **US strikes on Iran escalate**: The US broadened its campaign to include bridges, signaling a strategic shift. Iran warns of full-scale war. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy748n8zx8ro), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/17/g-s1-134158/us-iran-war-updates), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/18/targets-of-latest-us-strikes-on-iran-signal-strategic-shift?traffic_source=rss))
- **Russia clamps down on dissent**: Boris Nadezhdin barred from parliament, blogger Ilya Remeslo remanded in custody. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn0n3y6ewn4o))
- **Ukraine soldiers outraged over defense minister removal**: Mykhailo Fedorov's dismissal sparks protests and criticism from troops. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg8w4dpjkwo))
- **Magnitude 7.3 earthquake off Mexico**: Tsunami waves observed, but no major damage yet. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjv3815yxo))
- **Trump threatens Canada tariffs over wildfire smoke**: Cites 'filthy' air; Carney calls for climate action. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyq93j34lgo))

**Signal:** The US-Iran escalation is the most consequential overnight, with potential economic and geopolitical ripple effects across energy markets and global alliances.

日韩.zh:
日本修法保障男性皇位继承引发社会对性别平等的讨论；大阪校园安全事件受损；BTS演出激化日韩民间对立；日韩市场恐慌下加密货币受到关注。

- [日本皇室改革](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFA1dG1QUXh0alJWd05uR3VLX0JyYjVwcUxoWHk0WnZQX0RVMHZ3WlFGNWpPZ0Y0cC1fNkFjSm9xUWwyV0pMQkJzRGtnTTFiN0hwc2c0Z2wwdmh2aE9oZjV6dWJISkVtdGRLVWdB) — 公主婚后保留身份，但男性优先继承原则未变，民间对平等呼声上升。
- [Osaka junior high school incident](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQTzJUU2ItVFdsTVdwOVI5YmtqdGpNRmtCa29ieWhWQnpITmxRVUVKY0lYcHJTcUpUX0JLdTZ0blF5MHc2a2R6MWMtMG5ueXZhU0tCbEtmaWw1VjVnaU84Sm1NT2xXV2VZNnNuTk0yZzdUNW5xcTFYX2FOdU5hNFUwVmRSZkZPTWNEeUtjcHlJdFd5cGc) — 23人受伤，警方正调查喷洒物质，校园安全亟需加强。
- [BTS show shocks Japanese social media](https://news.google.) — 韩流文化在日引发争议，历史情感与当代娱乐碰撞。
- [Panic in Japan and South Korea markets: Crypto as winner?](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQOG9GelZuVEgxdmFFV3ZRRzNNMWVTZXIweDVhLWZsR20wcUV3REhROUppT180MmVRU0xlYXduOGktbVBTZWFTXzRpZGlRQkxGX3JMMlg3V1Z5UnNfLUxONEhZRWlMWWo5UGVRM1Vjd3EzVmdObXJxQXhlY2lEeHdnTHhkbGFQYVZDRE00eHJXbw) — 市场避险情绪升温，加密货币作为替代资产走强。

日韩社会在传统与现代、民族情感与区域合作之间摇摆，市场敏感度提高，后续关注日本皇室改革后续立法与韩日民间情绪管理。
日韩.en:
Market panic grips Japan and South Korea, with cryptocurrencies seen as a potential hedge. Japan passes a law to ensure male heirs to the imperial throne, sparking debate on royal reform. A BTS performance in Gwanghwamun shocks Japanese social media, an Osaka school substance spray injures 23, and South Korea sees surging demand for decaf coffee.

- **Markets in panic**: Japan and South Korea markets hit; crypto considered as a potential winner. ([CryptoRank](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQOG9GelZuVEgxdmFFV3ZRRzNNMWVTZXIweDVhLWZsR20wcUV3REhROUppT180MmVRU0xlYXduOGktbVBTZWFTXzRpZGlRQkxGX3JMMlg3V1Z5UnNfLUxONEhZRWlMWWo5UGVRM1Vjd3EzVmdObXJxQXhlY2lEeHdnTHhkbGFQYVZDRE00eHJXbw), [BeInCrypto](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE5Tem1CTWZEeFltOG1KRGNrYWt5YUV5SEVBeENQMTk0RGNRU2ZfYnY3MHQ5dVdzYTY4ZFZITS1DTTlWWVN2b3lQTTZTaHpIUlpIZDVSTmN4Znk4S1RfMmxMakpaYmRValRyb3ZtaTJJY2lqMV9DNGRjenFjbVE))
- **Japan royal succession law revised**: Ensures male heirs; princesses could keep status after marriage under proposed reforms. ([South Carolina Public Radio](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNOFJ2cVY5THdYRUhGY3ZhaEd0RUw3M2lwdThqVm82Q0F6Q2pidURONTg4UGFhZWx1bkU5U0FwNDg3OFd4OWpVUEJQbnFCVDVIbjFnQUFlUjZyWEJfWWVOS3hpWnpod3ZTR0F2OXJaQVBQU3VfRk9CZFlXVzJkQVlUdVJnekM0LUxveE9VZW40VDlMaHY1Nk5lRVJxTVc0T24xYklhZ1FIU1BSd09RSU44YnlSY3pKaEIxWWVxbms2dGNseXlWdXZB), [无忧资讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFA1dG1QUXh0alJWd05uR3VLX0JyYjVwcUxoWHk0WnZQX0RVMHZ3WlFGNWpPZ0Y0cC1fNkFjSm9xUWwyV0pMQkJzRGtnTTFiN0hwc2c0Z2wwdmh2aE9oZjV6dWJISkVtdGRLVWdB))
- **Osaka junior high school attack**: 23 injured by substance spray; police investigating. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQTzJUU2ItVFdsTVdwOVI5YmtqdGpNRmtCa29ieWhWQnpITmxRVUVKY0lYcHJTcUpUX0JLdTZ0blF5MHc2a2R6MWMtMG5ueXZhU0tCbEtmaWw1VjVnaU84Sm1NT2xXV2VZNnNuTk0yZzdUNW5xcTFYX2FOdU5hNFUwVmRSZkZPTWNEeUtjcHlJdFd5cGc))
- **BTS show shocks Japanese social media**: Cultural reactions highlight cross-border fan dynamics. ([Korea Times](https://news.google.))

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎热点以娱乐八卦、AI奇闻和争议话题为主，用户参与度较高但深度分析较少。

中国在AI治理领域占据议程设置权，国内社会保持稳定发展节奏，后续关注AI伦理行动计划的具体落地与国际反应。
中国.en:

**概览**：过去24小时，美国与伊朗的冲突烈度显著升级，双方互相打击基础设施，霍尔木兹海峡航运几近瘫痪；俄乌方向则出现教皇呼吁恢复粮食协议等外交声音。
- **美伊互攻基础设施**：美军连续第六夜对伊朗目标实施打击，声称击中数十处军事目标，但社交媒体显示民用桥梁被毁。伊朗暂无同等回应的报道。 ([Escalation fears mount as U.S., Iran attack infrastructure](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNUDlOZjJvQXFYYUVaSm9hbE83LWN0Z0pCVi0zWlp6OWZ6M3E2N1B1b1psblBQRl9VanVnazVZUkh6QTFrZVMwQzVqMkR1NUh4ZTFMQVlINTJwOE4wSDN1QmxaLXIxTU1MRVdBQVBfdHdNdkFmS3Nwbk9hOXhEdHZ0eVVTaTl0XzFVMjV3TDhSQk9OdEJKYWxHSWRxM0FVcnp4VXNWTHFOUGluUHZWejBmMTYtTQ))
- **航运市场急剧反应**：霍尔木兹海峡通行量暴跌，油轮保险费用飙升，油价周线收涨。美方宣称成功阻止油轮驶往伊朗。 ([Strait of Hormuz traffic plunges as US-Iran tensions rekindle shipping fears](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPQm9obVM1SU1hZVUzeVNGWmJIWHd5aDZLQldFdE9GREttNFBmTmFyRTg1UFl5MVFJZVJ2ZXhteXNsR2Vsdy1ybEFyVWd0VU95VEJRX2FvV0I0QjlESHdpTDJETm1mamZMRkJvMnJaZ0ZfZC1ZYm92bzNIX3ctSTJjRFRyZkFzZi1qVmJpZUg0RFUxS1NEQlhwU3pCYnBydzNfYWNRVE5tOTRYbk9JZzM2VmNZZ0R5QQ))
- **外交与战略评论**：著名学者米尔斯海默认为中东已进入全面战争边缘，并评论特朗普对俄政策。 ([John Mearsheimer: All-Out War in the Middle East & Trump’s War on Russia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPWXcyWm5EWEFqS3o4dlNwcDhTdFc1LUM4b1R2RjJqVmw5VXN5UzRmUnhsMEZydTkyRm1vcWh3RnpYcmdkd1FHdXNjelJ4SHlBQXRHUV9rVWdpMW8wenkyc3JRUGlCQm9OYXBYU0Q2eXMwY0NaMHFvZ2hSR2RmeVhHbVYyU0lmZW9WNHZwZVl0SUhNRmE3LW9VYmZlZWNmTzdGS0pja2Vn))
- **俄乌方向**：教皇向“俄罗斯兄弟们”呼吁恢复黑海粮食协议，但未获俄方积极回应；同时有分析认为华盛顿可能在改变对俄乌战争立场。 ([Is Washington Changing Course on Russia-Ukraine War?](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxOTkpVUGVJcTRLTUgyYVB4Rkg5RUtHWmlaMXdHVUhUNDBwRF9qRFVhR29tSlVkOFlOZkE2U3MxNm5XbVFXZlliSHozUmNYblV2ZzJsdUZOMFg1Z1ZQNXROVTVacXVkV2tSZXl0NHI1OF9YTG1DZ2JvbEd1YjJQUVZHM1hFRDFxTENzSjNwc1J3))

**判断**：美伊冲突正在从“代理人/威慑”模式转向“直接打击”模式，霍尔木兹海峡成为全球能源安全的致命脆弱点，投资者与政策制定者需为长期紧张做好准备。

U.S.-Iran tensions have exploded into open conflict over the Strait of Hormuz, with mutual infrastructure strikes and a blockade causing a dramatic drop in maritime traffic. The Pope has appealed to Russia to restore the grain agreement, while analysts warn of an all-out Middle East war.

国际安全.zh:
**概览**：美国军方加速产能建设与战略调整，但暴露出协调与执行层面的短板；澳大利亚军队为应对未来冲突进行实战化训练（模拟中国坦克）。
- **美军高超音速战略面临问责**：GAO报告指出海陆军缺乏统一高超音速导弹战略，导致海军“朱姆沃尔特”级改装进度落后两年，洛克希德·马丁公司量产能力不足。 ([Navy, Army risk wasting money, time without unified hypersonic missile strategy: GAO](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/navy-army-risk-wasting-money-time-without-unified-hypersonic-missile-strategy-gao/)) ([GAO: Lockheed Martin struggling to build Navy hypersonic missile at scale](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOUEtoWm5LMDltZFZrR0I2ZlVmSDhVVHF1YU9QbktRMU5mR0ZnQkowWmoxLVU1dmR4WnphcGpWTUxnY2MtYmlmQnN0WjJPWURvMG1LQkZpdTUzVndPNWFSMVAwUVhHV2pkSnRJMUxVLWkwMkdGeWtTNkhxTzZ2Uzh4NUV1blZZVWJjZl9iSXdDdG9ldldvWVA3cndVeUo2cjZBckwyVTV5Vnc5Zw))
- **“朱姆沃尔特”号完成改装重返舰队**：尽管面临延迟，该舰终于完成高超音速导弹系统安装，即将回归。其混合电力推进系统曾多次故障。 ([USS Zumwalt Set To Return To Fleet After Long Anticipated Hypersonic Missile Upgrade](https://www.twz.com/sea/uss-zumwalt-set-to-return-to-fleet-after-long-anticipated-hypersonic-missile-upgrade))
- **无人机战舰新纪元**：美国无人艇公司Saronic宣布在得克萨斯州投资30亿美元建设可建造850英尺级舰艇的船厂，显示无人水面作战平台从小型向大型化、规模化发展。 ([Drone Ship Maker Saronic Announces New $3B Shipyard In Texas Capable of Building 850-Foot Vessels](https://www.twz.com/sea/drone-ship-maker-saronic-announces-new-3b-shipyard-in-texas-capable-of-building-850-foot-vessels))
- **澳大利亚陆军将M1坦克伪装成中国坦克**：用于实兵对抗训练，提升针对假想敌的实战化水平，体现澳军对潜在冲突的备战姿态。 ([Australian Army Unveils Abrams Disguised As Chinese Tank](https://www.twz.com/land/australian-army-unveils-abrams-disguised-as-chinese-tank))
- **老导弹的新生命**：鱼叉反舰导弹服役近50年依然活跃，分析指出其技术升级与低成本使其在现代冲突中仍具价值。 ([The Harpoon Missile at (Almost) 50: How a Cold War Whale-Hunter Became the Free World's Ship-Killer](https://news.google.))

**判断**：美军在加速装备现代化过程中面临“量产陷阱”，高超音速武器等关键项目需要更高效的跨军种协同，否则可能重演此前隐身战机等项目的成本超支与延期。
国际安全.en:
The U.S. hypersonic missile program faces mounting criticism after a GAO report revealed the Navy is two years behind schedule on Zumwalt upgrades and Lockheed Martin is struggling to scale production. The Air Force is compensating by rapidly expanding procurement of stealthy cruise and anti-ship missiles, while new industrial investments emerge for drone ships and missile defense.

- **GAO warns of wasted money**: The Navy and Army lack a unified hypersonic strategy, risking billions. [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/navy-army-risk-wasting-money-time-without-unified-hypersonic-missile-strategy-gao/) and [DefenseScoop](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOUEtoWm5LMDltZFZrR0I2ZlVmSDhVVHF1YU9QbktRMU5mR0ZnQkowWmoxLVU1dmR4WnphcGpWTUxnY2MtYmlmQnN0WjJPWURvMG1LQkZpdTUzVndPNWFSMVAwUVhHV2pkSnRJMUxVLWkwMkdGeWtTNkhxTzZ2Uzh4NUV1blZZVWJjZl9iSXdDdG9ldldvWVA3cndVeUo2cjZBckwyVTV5Vnc5Zw)
- **USS Zumwalt returns after delay**: The destroyer is set to rejoin the fleet with hypersonic missiles, but power plant issues contributed to the delay. [TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/uss-zumwalt-set-to-return-to-fleet-after-long-anticipated-hypersonic-missile-upgrade) and [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/17/us-navy-2-years-behind-on-hypersonic-missile-installation-on-zumwalt-destroyers/)
- **Air Force boosts missile production**: Contracts for JASSM and LRASM expanded to 23,095 units to counter China. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/u-s-air-force-increases-stealthy-cruise-anti-ship-missile-production) and [Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQcThVTFpQMTllcE40NjhYYU1WV1FGRnliYnZHTXpkMXBiUVkzcVBrbmJPaUxTQXhKSENwQ2NhZmV1ZlItLWttSC1TbS1Peldybll6c2lJYTAxMV9SeG42TWhVLVhXQTRjQTFKNlZWRkg4NFFWclZ4aGZqUEVBcGxWMjJmLXkwcmx4RUlaYk04SFBIdGFRY3pzSnljWUI)
- **Drone ship maker goes big**: Saronic announces a $3B shipyard in Texas capable of building 850-foot vessels. [TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/drone-ship-maker-saronic-announces-new-3b-shipyard-in-texas-capable-of-building-850-foot-vessels)
- **Harpoon missile at 50**: The Cold War-era anti-ship missile refuses to retire as a key ship-killer. [19FortyFive](https://news.google.)

**Bottom line**: The U.S. is racing to modernize its missile arsenal amid industrial bottlenecks, but the hypersonic program's delays and lack of coordination may leave critical capability gaps for years.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览**：美海军在中东高强度执行封锁与打击任务，同时在印太方向推进导弹防御舰艇建设、盟国合作与大规模演习。
- **霍尔木兹海峡进入封锁状态**：美军中央司令部在重启伊朗封锁次日即击伤一艘试图靠近伊朗的油轮，使用“地狱火”导弹精准打击烟囱，航运量降至极低水平。 ([U.S. Disables Ship a Day Into Blockade, Strait of Hormuz Transits Hit Low As Risk Appetite Falls](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/u-s-disables-ship-a-day-into-blockade-strait-of-hormuz-transits-hit-low-as-risk-appetite-falls))
- **“金色卫士”导弹测量船敲定**：费城船厂将建造新型导弹测量船“金色卫士”，用于支持“金穹”导弹防御计划，设计基于国家安全多任务舰船型。 ([Philly Shipyard to Build ‘Golden Defender’ Ship as part of New Missile Defense Program](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/philly-shipyard-to-build-golden-defender-ship-as-part-of-new-missile-defense-program))
- **美空军扩大隐形反舰导弹产能**：AGM-158C LRASM采购量大幅增加，旨在加强针对海上目标的远程打击能力，应对中国海军扩张。 ([U.S. Air Force Increases Stealthy Cruise, Anti-ship Missile Production](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/u-s-air-force-increases-stealthy-cruise-anti-ship-missile-production))
- **法国太平洋司令证实中国提前通报SLBM试射**：法国海军少将表示中国提前通报了潜射弹道导弹试射，法方将其视为核威慑可信度的展示，同时确认法国作为太平洋常驻力量的身份。 ([French Pacific Commander Says France Had Advance Notice of China’s SLBM Launch](https://www.navalnews.com/interviews/2026/07/france-advance-notice-china-slbm-launch/))
- **日本与越南联合发展快速登陆艇**：两国达成合作意向，拓展防务工业合作，这是日本深化印太安全伙伴关系的一部分。 ([Japan and Vietnam to Jointly Develop Fast Landing Craft](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/japan-vietnam-fast-landing-craft-development/))
- **西班牙海军领导北约大西洋特遣队**：西班牙海军将领导北约大西洋特遣队至2027年6月，部署5艘舰艇及8艘盟国舰艇，确保北大西洋安全。 ([Spanish Navy to Lead NATO’s Atlantic Task Force Until June 2027](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/spanish-navy-to-lead-natos-atlantic-task-force-until-june-2027))

**判断**：霍尔木兹海峡的军事封锁已成为当前全球海运安全的“黑天鹅”，而法方透露的中国提前通报SLBM试射则显示大国间在太平洋的战略沟通机制仍然存在，避免直接误判。日越防务合作值得关注，可能改变南海力量平衡。
海军与印太.en:
The Strait of Hormuz crisis dominates naval headlines, with the U.S. disabling a tanker during its blockade and transits at historic lows. Meanwhile, the Spanish Navy takes leadership of NATO's Atlantic task force, and Japan-Vietnam defense cooperation deepens with a fast landing craft project.

- **U.S. disables ship in blockade**: CENTCOM forces shot Hellfire missiles into the smokestack of a tanker ignoring warnings; Strait of Hormuz transits hit low. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/u-s-disables-ship-a-day-into-blockade-strait-of-hormuz-transits-hit-low-as-risk-appetite-falls)
- **Golden Defender missile monitor ship**: Hanwha Philly Shipyard to build a new missile-range instrumentation vessel for the Golden Dome program. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/philly-shipyard-to-build-golden-defender-ship-as-part-of-new-missile-defense-program) and [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/new-golden-defender-missile-monitor-ship-to-be-built-at-hanwha-philly-shipyard/)
- **RIMPAC underway**: The at-sea phase of RIMPAC 2026 is ongoing; Singapore Navy frigate RSS Steadfast fired an Aster missile. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-17-2026)
- **Spanish Navy leads NATO Atlantic task force**: Five Spanish ships and eight allied vessels will patrol the North Atlantic until June 2027. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/17/spanish-navy-to-lead-natos-atlantic-task-force-until-june-2027)
- **Japan-Vietnam landing craft**: Tokyo and Hanoi agree to jointly develop fast landing craft, marking deeper defense-industrial ties. [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/japan-vietnam-fast-landing-craft-development/)

**Bottom line**: The U.S. Navy is stretched between a hot war in the Middle East and a deterrence posture in the Indo-Pacific, while allies step up in both theaters.

中国军情.zh:
**概览**：南海仲裁案十周年之际，中国加大海上主权声索力度，通过官方媒体与外交渠道强调立场；同时与俄罗斯军事合作持续深化，但遭到澳大利亚等国反制。
- **中国国防部重申南海主权**：针对菲律宾方面政治作秀，国防部表态“改变不了有关岛礁属于中国的事实”。 ([国防部：菲方一些人搞政治作秀改变不了有关岛礁属于中国的事实](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBLSDBnaHlzZkZPWUxzaW1TOERNb1pBc3hyeTVYVmRIeGN1bzNPZWc2X09WNFJicjlpbUVEZEJtcXR4U3hPRW1HUHppcmNHcEI4UWVsNHY1RkR4MzdlVEExQjdUTlFqSXpBVjNGQjNJVkFmUG4tN0ZFVXR0eWI))
- **官媒AI视频贬损菲律宾人引抗议**：中国官媒使用AI技术制作视频将菲律宾人描绘成猴子，菲外交部要求下架，防长斥为“卑劣宣传”。此举激化中菲舆论战。 ([中国官媒AI视频将菲人描绘成猴子 菲外交部要求下架 防长斥卑劣宣传](https://news.google.))
- **澳瓦协定阻止中国建军事基地**：澳大利亚与瓦努阿图签署防务协定，旨在阻止中国在瓦努阿图建立军事基地或监听站，反映南太地缘竞争升温。 ([澳大利亚和瓦努阿图签署协定，阻止中国建立军事基地](https://news.google.))
- **中俄军事合作受关注**：国防部回应称希望各方客观理性看待中俄军事合作，暗示西方不应过度解读。 ([中国国防部：希望有关方客观理性看待中俄军事合作](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFBJSklNQkt0WU96LUYtSEJQQmdmbk5qeVRqQzNzQXd2VTRmMkxoVlcxNEJDOUpMUWdBanQ4aXZUTTB5YV9wQ3otd253X3N6SWgtYUliLXJTbzJDVEtDeTVJYWFwSG8xZUFh))
- **美议员推动限制资本流入中国军工企业**：美国议员致函证监会主席，呼吁限制美国资本投资中国军事企业，这是中美技术竞争的新战线。 ([美议员致函美证交会主席，呼吁限制美国资本流入中国军事企业](https://news.google.))

**判断**：南海仲裁十周年之际，中国采取更为强硬的舆论与外交姿态，AI视频风波显示信息战手段升级；但美澳的联合反制（资本限制、基地协定）正在压缩中国在南海与南太的战略空间，未来博弈将更趋复杂。
中国军情.en:
China continues to assert its claims in the South China Sea, marking the tenth anniversary of the arbitration ruling with increased activity. Australia and Vanuatu signed an agreement to block Chinese military basing, while Chinese state media sparked controversy with an AI-generated video insulting Filipinos.

- **Australia-Vanuatu base denial**: The two countries sign a pact to prevent China from establishing a military base in Vanuatu. [Indo-Pacific Defense FORUM](https://news.google.)
- **U.S. lawmakers target Chinese military firms**: Letter to SEC chair calls for restricting American capital flows into Chinese military-linked companies. [美国之音](https://news.google.)
- **AI propaganda video**: Chinese state media AI video depicting Filipinos as monkeys sparks outrage; Philippines demands removal. [RFI](https://news.google.)
- **Defense Ministry statements**: China reiterates sovereignty over South China Sea islands, dismisses Philippine political stunts; urges objective view of China-Russia military cooperation. [新浪军事](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBLSDBnaHlzZkZPWUxzaW1TOERNb1pBc3hyeTVYVmRIeGN1bzNPZWc2X09WNFJicjlpbUVEZEJtcXR4U3hPRW1HUHppcmNHcEI4UWVsNHY1RkR4MzdlVEExQjdUTlFqSXpBVjNGQjNJVkFmUG4tN0ZFVXR0eWI) and [chinanews.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFBJSklNQkt0WU96LUYtSEJQQmdmbk5qeVRqQzNzQXd2VTRmMkxoVlcxNEJDOUpMUWdBanQ4aXZUTTB5YV9wQ3otd253X3N6SWgtYUliLXJTbzJDVEtDeTVJYWFwSG8xZUFh)
- **South China Sea anniversary**: Ten years after the 2016 arbitration ruling, Beijing increases its presence and rhetoric. [Radio Free Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE5vOW1tRmtWZHp1M0Z3MWt6bWkzYnZVOGgzSHNyMEtob2dWNURheFJrVGp5ZmtFN2RXQ2tqS2VILWhjNXFrcXVfNktianJVQTNXQUdoUmtNSE81UTN1MDVRTGo1QUxkUmdYS255d1ZUQXpqMGhXdDRSUkJVcw)

**Bottom line**: China is facing increased pushback in the South China Sea and the Pacific, while simultaneously using new tools like AI for information warfare, signaling a multi-dimensional strategy to secure its interests.

科技产品.zh: 科技产品线昨日多起事件指向**系统信任危机**与**监管收紧**。**AWS**出现计费故障，部分用户账单从几美分飙升至数十亿美元（[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/amazon-web-services-glitch-oh-no/)），虽然已修复但暴露了云服务商“计费黑箱”风险。**旧金山检察官**要求苹果和Google下架所有“脱衣”App，认定其违反加州法律（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/apple-and-google-ordered-to-purge-nudify-apps-from-app-stores/)），这是继国会听证后地方监管对应用商店审核的又一记重拳。**博彩平台Polymarket**的巴拿马空壳公司结构被曝光，连前员工都说不清其公司架构（[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/whats-up-with-polymarkets-panama-entity/)），合规风险隐现。**Zoox**因烟雾环境下自动驾驶决策混乱而发布软件召回（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217803/zoox-issues-software-recall-because-its-robotaxis-may-be-confused-by-smoke/)），呼应NHTSA对应急场景的严格要求。值得关注的还有**Pebble创始人**谈及30天保修政策，强调“信任”（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/967471/pebble-smartwatch-warranty-repairs-migicovsky-interview)），这场复古硬件回归是否经得起检验尚待观察。印象：平台型产品的容错空间正在缩小，监管与用户信任成为决定生死的关键变量。
科技产品.en:
Consumer and enterprise tech products faced a turbulent 24 hours, marked by a cloud billing nightmare, regulatory action against harmful apps, and a recall tied to wildfire smoke. The AWS glitch reminds enterprises of the risks in monolithic cloud dependencies, while San Francisco's crackdown on 'nudify' apps pressures app store operators to enforce state laws more aggressively. Meanwhile, Pebble's founder defends a controversially short warranty as a trust-building exercise.

- **AWS billing glitch:** An error in Amazon Web Services' billing system caused some customers' monthly bills to skyrocket from cents to billions of dollars ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/amazon-web-services-glitch-oh-no/)). The event raises questions about cloud cost monitoring and accountability.
- **Apple and Google ordered to purge 'nudify' apps:** San Francisco City Attorney David Chiu sent letters demanding the removal of apps generating non-consensual nude images, citing state law violations ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/apple-and-google-ordered-to-purge-nudify-apps-from-app-stores/)).
- **Zoox recall due to smoke confusion:** The robotaxi maker issued a software recall because its vehicles may react unpredictably to smoke, responding to NHTSA's call for better emergency handling ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217803/zoox-issues-software-recall-because-its-robotaxis-may-be-confused-by-smoke/)).
- **Pebble founder defends 30-day warranty:** Eric Migicovsky argues that trust, not warranty length, defines the relationship with buyers of the new e-paper smartwatch ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/967471/pebble-smartwatch-warranty-repairs-migicovsky-interview)).
- **Nuclear startup Valar Atomics seeks $6B valuation:** The company is in talks for complex multi-stage funding, highlighting investor appetite for advanced nuclear tech ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/nuclear-startup-valar-atomics-in-talks-to-raise-new-funding-at-6b-valuation/)).

**Signal:** The combination of cloud billing failures and regulatory clampdowns suggests a tightening scrutiny on both backend infrastructure and app store governance—watch for more state-level interventions.

AI.zh: AI板块昨日**监管信号**与**行业震荡**并存。**印度智能手机市场**因AI功能带来的内存需求飙升而出现“内存荒”，导致出货放缓（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/ai-driven-memory-crunch-jolts-indias-smartphone-market/)），AI对硬件供应链的衍射效应加速显现。**美国政策层**拟参照金融业FINRA模式设立AI模型审查机构（[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-17/us-considers-creating-finra-like-watchdog-to-vet-top-ai-models)），若落地将彻底改变开源模型发布机制。**Alphabet**因核心AI研究员离职导致股价下跌（[Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBDcktQcUJfMGViRGlpMmg4SGJocFZ5STA4TTZZZ3BVdVVkeFJtbzZ2MEFzRGhlcDFiNzl0dUtvUlhBbnVSOWdzQnRHMFpNN0VQVHg2QjlFN0tkcDFJVWhFWkhlaFFvLXZlMkQtRHJLaHBfSkJmUU9LdDAzVnlUZw)），人才争夺战白热化。**Databricks**以1880亿美元估值完成新一轮融资（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/databricks-hits-188b-valuation-extending-its-run-as-ais-favorite-second-act/)），验证了“AI基建”商业模式的延续性。**Meta**被曝考虑与Anthropic签署数十亿美元数据中心协议（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217904/meta-is-reportedly-considering-a-multibillion-dollar-data-center-deal-with-anthropic/)），云计算被巨头重新定义。最引发社区共鸣的是**Kaiser护士**的抗议——他们表示AI监控和代码审查反而降低了护理质量，249条Hacker News评论直指技术部署中“效率凌驾于关怀”的困境（[Local News Matters](https://localnewsmatters.org/2026/07/15/kaiser-nurses-say-ai-workplace-surveillance-are-making-their-jobs-and-patient-care-worse/)）。
AI.en:
AI's influence is rippling through markets, regulation, and labor. A memory crunch from AI demand is stalling India's smartphone market, while the US considers a financial-style watchdog for AI models. Inside the workplace, Kaiser nurses are pushing back against AI surveillance, and Meta explores a massive data center deal with Anthropic. Open-source and user-facing AI tools continue to proliferate, from Claude's new 'Fable 5' tier to a scheduler that flags AI-sounding posts.

- **US considers AI watchdog modeled on FINRA:** A Bloomberg report indicates the government is exploring a regulatory body to vet top AI models, signaling a shift toward proactive oversight ([Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-17/us-considers-creating-finra-like-watchdog-to-vet-top-ai-models)).
- **AI-driven memory crunch jolts India's smartphone market:** TechCrunch reports that the AI boom is causing memory shortages, raising prices and slowing sales in the world's second-largest smartphone market ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/ai-driven-memory-crunch-jolts-indias-smartphone-market/)).
- **Kaiser nurses protest AI workplace surveillance:** A Hacker News front-page story (370 points, 249 comments) details how AI monitoring is harming patient care and nurse morale ([localnewsmatters.org](https://localnewsmatters.org/2026/07/15/kaiser-nurses-say-ai-workplace-surveillance-are-making-their-jobs-and-patient-care-worse/)).
- **Meta reportedly in talks for multibillion-dollar data center deal with Anthropic:** This would open a new business line for Meta as an infrastructure provider for leading AI labs ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217904/meta-is-reportedly-considering-a-multibillion-dollar-data-center-deal-with-anthropic/)).
- **Claude Fable 5 to be included in Max plans starting July 20:** Anthropic announced the upgrade, signaling continued feature expansion for premium users ([Twitter](https://twitter.com/claudeai/status/2078302415804379218)).

**Signal:** AI regulation is moving from talk to active design, with implications for model development cycles and compliance costs. Watch for the FINRA-like proposal's details and the outcome of Meta-Anthropic negotiations.

汽车.zh: 汽车圈昨日迎来**历史性节点**：**德国**6月纯电动车（BEV）销量首次超过燃油车，成为汽车发源地的电动转型里程碑（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/in-the-birthplace-of-the-automobile-electric-cars-are-now-king/)）。**特斯拉**同时在拉脱维亚和乌拉圭开售，完成波罗的海三国覆盖，南美市场也增至三国（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/tesla-latvia-uruguay-launch/)），全球化攻势不减。**比亚迪**发布高端子品牌腾势Z9S，续航超920公里、1200马力（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/byd-unveils-new-luxury-ev-1200-hp-570-miles-range/)），目标直指豪华电动轿车市场。**大众**ID.Polo低价版（37kWh电池，起价不到3万美元）推出后已获2.5万份订单（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/volkswagen-id-polo-ev-orders-hit-25000-in-weeks-cheaper-version-launches/)），欧洲平价电动化加速。**丰田**在美国加州提供3000美元换购补贴，鼓励车主用旧EV置换其新款bZ SUV（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/toyota-offers-3000-to-trade-in-old-ev-for-new-electric-suv/)），显示传统车企正以“以旧换新”策略争夺存量用户。此外**Agility Robotics**在特斯拉工厂所在地弗雷蒙特开设Digit机器人训练中心（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/agility-robotics-plants-its-flag-in-teslas-backyard/)），汽车与机器人融合趋势愈发清晰。
汽车.en:
The electrification race accelerated across geographies: Tesla entered Latvia and Uruguay, Germany recorded BEVs outselling gasoline cars for the first time, and BYD unveiled a luxury sedan with 570 miles of range. Volkswagen's ID. Polo EV secured 25,000 orders quickly, while Toyota offers $3,000 trade-in incentives for its new bZ electric SUV. Agility Robotics opened a humanoid robot training center in Tesla's backyard, signaling convergence of automotive and robotics.

- **Tesla expands into Latvia and Uruguay:** Two new markets in 24 hours, completing Baltic coverage and adding a third South American market ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/tesla-latvia-uruguay-launch/)).
- **Germany: BEVs outsell gas cars for the first time:** June sales record shows battery-electric vehicles as the most popular powertrain in the birthplace of the automobile ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/in-the-birthplace-of-the-automobile-electric-cars-are-now-king/)).
- **BYD unveils Denza Z9S luxury sedan:** With 1,200 hp and 570 miles (920 km) range, it raises the bar for high-end EVs ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/byd-unveils-new-luxury-ev-1200-hp-570-miles-range/)).
- **Volkswagen ID. Polo EV gets 25,000 orders, cheaper variant launched:** The 37 kWh version starts under $30,000, widening EV accessibility ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/17/volkswagen-id-polo-ev-orders-hit-25000-in-weeks-cheaper-version-launches/)).
- **Agility Robotics opens Digit training center in Fremont, CA:** The startup plants its flag in Tesla's backyard, focusing on robot deployment in logistics ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/17/agility-robotics-plants-its-flag-in-teslas-backyard/)).

**Signal:** The EV market is entering a phase of geographic and model diversification—Germany's milestone and BYD's range leadership could force legacy automakers to accelerate their timelines.

HackNews社区动态.zh: HackNews社区昨日的技术内容兼具**安全曝光**与**开源创新**。**TP-Link Kasa EC71摄像头**被曝长达六年通过未认证UDP端口泄露家庭GPS坐标，涉及大量用户（[GitHub](https://github.com/BadChemical/IoT-Vulnerability-Research-Public/blob/main/TP-Link_Kasa_EC71/Kasa_EC71.md)），60点热度、12条评论，提醒智能家居厂商需反思“默认可访问”设计。**FAA**重新允许波音自行签署737 MAX和787的适航证书（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/faa-boeing-737-max-787.html)），143点讨论激烈，评论担忧监管独立性倒退。**Isomorphic Labs**发布药物设计引擎，号称超越AlphaFold开启新前沿（[Isomorphic Labs](https://www.isomorphiclabs.com/articles/the-isomorphic-labs-drug-design-engine-unlocks-a-new-frontier)），50点赞，AI+制药进入新阶段。**Open Book Touch**开源电子书阅读器在Crowd Supply众筹（[Crowd Supply](https://www.crowdsupply.com/oddly-specific-objects/open-book-touch)），77点赞，社区对开放硬件热情不减。**Tokio团队**发布Rust全栈框架Topcoat（[GitHub](https://github.com/tokio-rs/topcoat)），55点赞、32条评论，异步Rust生态向Web开发延伸。另外**静态搜索树**论文（2024）以40倍加速引爆讨论（[curiouscoding.nl](https://curiouscoding.nl/posts/static-search-tree/)），67点赞，算法优化永不过时。
HackNews社区动态.en:
Hacker News today is a rich mix of open-source tooling, hardware hacking, and critical IoT security disclosures. Moonstone, a modern Lua runtime written in Zig, gained traction alongside a 3D-printable solder paste stencil generator (Stenchill). A major vulnerability in TP-Link Kasa cameras exposed home GPS coordinates for six years, while the FAA's decision to let Boeing self-certify again sparked debate. Isomorphic Labs' drug design engine and a static search tree algorithm post also drew significant interest.

- **Moonstone: Modern Lua runtime in Zig:** A cross-platform package manager and runtime, generating 19 points and discussion on open-source language ecosystems ([moonstone.sh](https://moonstone.sh/)).
- **TP-Link Kasa cameras leaked GPS via UDP:** Unauthenticated broadcasts exposed home locations for six years; 60 points, 12 comments on the vulnerability research ([GitHub](https://github.com/BadChemical/IoT-Vulnerability-Research-Public/blob/main/TP-Link_Kasa_EC71/Kasa_EC71.md)).
- **FAA lets Boeing self-certify 737 MAX and 787 again:** The agency restores Boeing's authority, a controversial step that gained 143 points and 76 comments on HN ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/faa-boeing-737-max-787.html)).
- **Open Book Touch: open-source e-reader:** Crowd Supply campaign for a fully open e-reader reached 77 points, highlighting maker interest in customizable hardware ([Crowd Supply](https://www.crowdsupply.com/oddly-specific-objects/open-book-touch)).
- **Topcoat: Full-stack framework for Rust from Tokio team:** 55 points, 32 comments on a new framework aiming to simplify Rust web development ([GitHub](https://github.com/tokio-rs/topcoat)).

**Signal:** The community is balancing enthusiasm for new open-source tools with heightened awareness of IoT security flaws—the TP-Link disclosure and Boeing's renewed self-certification both point to trust and transparency as core themes.

足球.zh:
英格兰半决赛失利的余波仍在发酵：图赫尔赛后坚称战术无误，但特朗普公开质疑哈里·凯恩下半场“被改造成防守球员”；鲁尼则建议足总除非能请到瓜迪奥拉，否则应继续信任图赫尔。决赛双方西班牙与阿根廷言语交锋升级，拉波尔特暗示阿根廷踢法“粗暴”。转会市场方面，阿斯顿维拉以5950万英镑队史标王价签下弗赖堡中场曼赞比，截胡纽卡斯尔；巴萨则将劳塔罗、谢什科等人列为“小蜘蛛”阿尔瓦雷斯的备选。南安普顿主帅埃克特透露“间谍门”期间曾受警方保护。
