- [Villa sign Newcastle target Manzambi in club-record deal](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13564492/johan-manzambi-aston-villa-sign-newcastle-target-from-freiburg-in-club-record-59-5m-deal) 
- [Saints boss Eckert reveals police protection amid threats during 'Spygate'](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13564527/tonda-eckert-exclusive-southampton-boss-reveals-he-received-police-protection-after-threats-during-spygate-scandal) 

**收束判断**：英格兰的未来计划悬而未决，世界杯决赛则成为两种足球哲学的终极碰撞；转会窗大动作预示着新赛季豪门军备竞赛已经提前打响。
足球.en:
The football world is fixated on the aftermath of England's World Cup semi-final defeat and the looming final between Spain and Argentina. Manager Thomas Tuchel faced sharp criticism but received backing from Wayne Rooney, while Trump's unusual intervention added a political dimension. Meanwhile, Spain's camp radiates collective calm, and Aston Villa completed a blockbuster £59.5m signing.

- **Tuchel's defiance and Rooney's support**: Tuchel described the loss as 'a scar we carry now' and defended his decisions. Rooney advised the FA to stick with Tuchel unless Guardiola becomes available. [Defiant Tuchel](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3r0l4zn9jpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) | [Rooney's view](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c304ldrmmero?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Trump questions Kane's role**: The US President criticized England's use of Harry Kane as a defensive player in the second half, amplifying domestic discontent. [Trump on Kane](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cjej3y1jgdpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Spain-Argentina final preview**: Aymeric Laporte warned Argentina 'like to leave a mark,' while Azpilicueta stressed Spain's team identity. Hupu community also noted that of 52 players in the final squads, 24 play in La Liga. [Laporte](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj63e8l0kjjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) | [Azpilicueta](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/czxedvre7ryo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) | [Squad stats](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQQXBQMGU5eXk4dk0welMxZ2gwejQ1NFdDUXVPTDBvbDZHNGZhZkJkWk9FZ3QydlRUVnpmZ0pvQ3dLMGNPZlZJNHFXb25jcFZ1amJuaS11RzRjZG9QRVpuV1NxZzkzNUNINTlWblNRajJ0TzdmTDJ3VjVmY0Z0TERXM09YY3FJUzQ5RmdtbndPNzBFLUE)
- **Aston Villa break transfer record**: Villa signed Freiburg midfielder Johan Manzambi for £59.5m, beating Newcastle in a club-record deal that could reshape their midfield. [Transfer news](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13564492/johan-manzambi-aston-villa-sign-newcastle-target-from-freiburg-in-club-record-59-5m-deal)
- **Southampton boss reveals threats**: Tonda Eckert said he received police protection during the 'Spygate' scandal, highlighting the intense pressure on managers. [Eckert exclusive](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13564527/tonda-eckert-exclusive-southampton-boss-reveals-he-received-police-protection-after-threats-during-spygate-scandal)
- **Barcelona transfer targets**: Reports indicate Barcelona is searching for alternatives to 'Little Spider' Julian Alvarez, with interest in Kroupi, Lautaro Martinez, and Sesko. [Barca search](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE50djEteFJGTzgwQzYySXJtcTJjaDhtRzZ5bzhtN1ljZzJpMUhoRnlZWTg0QXFvcGpYbVBXdl9wRTNtT0dUVGpBYmo0WXh6SmtEOVgtM0xR)

With the World Cup final on Sunday, attention will peak on Spain vs Argentina. Transfer activity is likely to accelerate as clubs prepare for the new season.

羽毛球.zh:
2026日本羽毛球公开赛八强战上演“超级冷门日”——世界排名前三的球员安洗莹、山口茜、陈雨菲同日出局，男单头号种子石宇奇在先胜一局后被逆转。女单方面，王祉怡苦战三局以1-2不敌印尼选手瓦尔达尼，决胜局仅得4分，七连胜遭终结，无缘半决赛对阵山口茜。混双“凤凰组合”（冯彦哲/黄东萍）则表现强势，以21-5横扫全英赛冠军，晋级四强，半决赛将客场挑战日本组合。

- [国羽4胜3负收官，连爆大冷世界第1第2第3都止步8强：石宇奇被逆转](https://news.google.) 
- [决胜局4-21溃不成军！王祉怡1-2瓦尔达尼，7连胜终结无缘战山口茜](https://news.google.) 
- [单局21-5吊打全英赛冠军！凤凰组合2-0晋级，半决赛挑战日本魔鬼主场](https://news.google.) 
- [瓦尔达尼终破前五](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE4xMkJ6dlZxVlpuZ1BzMkdZb3lHUGx3bXpWZ29xTFVEcDRBS1BzczhXYjl6SzlsLUUtQzBfY3RXWDVjLWwzNVhqOGJvSzcyblBFdXlSYjFMM3BEdzJEWDVVcmlyUQ) 

**收束判断**：本站超级赛彻底打乱了奥运积分周期格局，国羽男单、女单均暴露出稳定性问题；混双“凤凰组合”能否在客场逆境中保持强势，成为后续最大看点。
羽毛球.en:
The Japan Open delivered a day of massive upsets as top seeds across men's and women's singles exited in the quarter-finals. China's team finished 4-3, but the losses of key players like Shi Yuqi and Wang Zhiyi sent shockwaves through the tournament. The mixed doubles pair 'Phoenix' advanced with a dominant performance, setting up a semi-final challenge in a hostile Japanese arena.

- **All top three seeds fall**: World No.1, No.2, and No.3 were all eliminated in the quarter-finals—a highly unusual outcome that resets the power dynamics. China's Shi Yuqi, the men's singles top seed, was eliminated. [Reuters summary](https://news.google.)
- **Wang Zhiyi's shock defeat**: China's women's singles hope Wang Zhiyi lost to Indonesia's Wardani in three games, with a disastrous 4-21 final set, ending her seven-match winning streak and missing a chance to face Yamaguchi. [Details](https://news.google.)
- **Phoenix pair dominates**: The mixed doubles duo 'Feng Huang' (Phoenix) crushed the All England champions 21-5 in one game, winning 2-0, and will now face a tough semi-final in Japan's 'devil's home' environment. [Report](https://news.google.)
- **Wardani breaks into top 5**: After eliminating Wang Zhiyi, Indonesia's Wardani cracked the world top five for the first time, marking a career breakthrough. [Breakthrough story](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE4xMkJ6dlZxVlpuZ1BzMkdZb3lHUGx3bXpWZ29xTFVEcDRBS1BzczhXYjl6SzlsLUUtQzBfY3RXWDVjLWwzNVhqOGJvSzcyblBFdXlSYjFMM3BEdzJEWDVVcmlyUQ)

Semifinals later today will determine if any of the survivors can capitalize on the chaos. The Phoenix pair's match will be a key test of nerve in a noisy Japanese arena.

虎扑社区动态.en:
Hupu community activity surged around esports and football. The heated DK vs BLG match in League of Legends drew intense criticism of BLG top laner Bin, while T1's victory over HLE sparked a player rating frenzy. Football content included analysis of World Cup final squads and transfer rumors, plus an old interview where Cucurella said he would quit the national team after winning the World Cup—now relevant given Spain's final appearance.

- **Fans blast Bin after DK defeat**: In the LCK vs LPL clash, Hupu users called Bin 'selfish' and 'a giant baby', saying his constant greed for farm and late teamfight arrival cost BLG. The post went viral. [Bin criticism](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1yODROVjI0UGRTTE5HZTZFV0d2WnM0b2s0RUh5V3JfcGd6XzYwY1Jod1ZTYV83UDhJeWJvV3o2TlNtLU51YUt5YjcyWXBXcU90ZVdid0c4OVVIdy1DVFgzcGFCOA)
- **T1 vs HLE sparks ratings**: Hupu's player rating feature saw thousands of votes as T1 beat HLE, with users dissecting individual performances. [T1 rating](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9ob1JReGIwa3VNMGFiazcwSFJLTjU5YzdNLUtWOXJEVU1CcnRPRzZYRXM5TlJ0RDJmVnBPMjhvZ1J0NUlVc29LUDRxQ1ppbmtrdkxpS2tUYzQ3WTFzZ3lPZ1pXQQ)
- **World Cup final squad breakdown**: A post highlighted that of 52 players in the Spain vs Argentina squads, 24 play in La Liga—a stat that sparked debate about league quality. [Squad stats](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQQXBQMGU5eXk4dk0welMxZ2gwejQ1NFdDUXVPTDBvbDZHNGZhZkJkWk9FZ3QydlRUVnpmZ0pvQ3dLMGNPZlZJNHFXb25jcFZ1amJuaS11RzRjZG9QRVpuV1NxZzkzNUNINTlWblNRajJ0TzdmTDJ3VjVmY0Z0TERXM09YY3FJUzQ5RmdtbndPNzBFLUE)
- **Cucurella's old quote resurfaces**: A 2025 interview resurfaced where Spain's Marcos Cucurella said he would retire from the national team the day after winning the World Cup. With Spain in the final, Hupu users speculated whether he might follow through. [Cucurella quote](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE8xTEdKX25WM0pCSFhYdXFYcTlvQURXRnpYLVJsOVRIMFRfclRFa3pRUEtqMEJOUm02SXdzOExITno5bWc3ZFp1d2M0RUxKdzY4UEFpRnpR)
- **JDG birthday wish for 'Wushuang'**: JD Gaming celebrated their jungler Wushuang's 21st birthday, saying 'summer isn't over yet'—a message of hope for their season. [JDG post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE5rcmlrQ0ZRejJ2YURRSjhDWFZoVUFPc0Z1bDIzbG1KdEVhcW1hb0txQ0tVaTUwcEVuSW5qc0hIUThoNGtENEcwZEprMlB4ZHdKM1gwVTFB)

Hupu will likely focus on the World Cup final and continued esports matchups. The community's unique blend of gaming and traditional sports commentary makes it a bellwether for Chinese fan sentiment.

篮球.zh:
NBA休赛期消息面相对平静，但詹姆斯在最新访谈中的发言仍具话题性。他表示迈克尔·乔丹是其篮球领域的榜样，而说唱歌手Jay Z则是生活中的“大哥”。此外，竞彩篮球今日直播渠道已汇总，可供投注参考。

篮球.en:
Basketball coverage in the last 24 hours was limited but included a notable personal reflection from LeBron James on his role models and a promotional piece for betting channels. The James story resonated on Hupu, where fans engaged with his comparison of Michael Jordan (basketball) and Jay-Z (life). No major league games or breaking news occurred.

- **LeBron James on Jordan and Jay-Z**: In an interview, James described Jordan as his basketball idol and Jay-Z as a 'big brother' figure and life role model. The quote spread quickly on Chinese platforms. [James interview](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBJU2h0Y2hTRWVYdWhzQ2M3cnhLRzVvUHlyeGhZRlJNUEVrWGcwOFNacEM4TWxLUHlsSF82Z1M1aGFwNER0NWRqdjNqTVJMUmtDS0tUWC1R)
- **Betting information roundup**: A Chinese sports media outlet aggregated official channels for live betting on basketball, indicating continued interest in wagering despite regulatory scrutiny. [Betting channels](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE84N09pTmtYTDBsZEp1QldSZmNSZEV6RkU0dVlCdEdJUUJEMUk3UXlibXJzNVZHdU1IeUphYmpBTkZaTXhFaHFuVjl3cXNIT3VCU2RLNGxsZkVkRHVtVjFEd2NWSjE3d0xXSFdBNVVkNWhOT1VGNzBr)

With the NBA offseason in full swing, expect more stories on player training, international events, and potential trades to emerge in the coming days. The James quote may generate further discussion on leadership and legacy.

欧美.zh:
诺兰史诗《奥德赛》今日释出完整卡司图解，马特·达蒙饰演奥德修斯，阵容囊括奥斯卡、艾美、托尼奖得主，堪称近年好莱坞资源配置的巅峰。同时，汤姆·布拉迪在Fanatics Fest上掌掴洛根·保罗，虽被疑是WWE促销剧本，但已为周六社群制造了海量二创素材。艾美奖削减奖项类别引发三大工会联合抗议，Lorde炮轰Spotify AI功能——好莱坞正处于内容狂欢与行业规则震荡的交汇点。

- [《The Odyssey》卡司指南](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/the-odyssey-cast-characters-christopher-nolan/)
- [布拉迪vs保罗：掌掴事件真假辨](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/tom-brady-logan-paul-slap-fanatics-fest-wwe-promo-1236651395/)
- [三大工会抗议艾美奖削项](https://deadline.com/2026/07/dga-wga-sag-aftra-reaction-emmys-cut-categories-telecast-1236997353/)
- [Lorde抵制Spotify AI](https://deadline.com/2026/07/lorde-calls-out-spotify-ai-about-the-song-feature-1236997350/)
- [Colman Domingo参与创作公主蒂安娜真人电影](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/colman-domingo-live-action-princess-tiana-movie-robert-ohara-princess-and-the-frog-1236815248/)

好莱坞正以IP豪赌（《奥德赛》《蒂安娜》）对冲流媒体转型阵痛，但AI与奖项公平性议题可能成为下半年更持久的叙事。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk saw a confluence of high-profile film releases, industry disputes, and viral celebrity moments. Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' dominates both analysis and cast appreciation, while the Emmys' decision to cut categories has united Hollywood guilds in protest. The Tom Brady-Logan Paul slap incident exemplifies the blurring line between sports, entertainment, and staged performance.

- **'The Odyssey' Unpacked**: Variety's timeline explainer ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/the-odyssey-explained-timelines-monsters-greek-legend-1236813704/)) and THR's cast guide ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/the-odyssey-cast-characters-christopher-nolan/)) provide essential context for Nolan's non-linear narrative, starring Matt Damon and a roster of A-listers.
- **Emmys Controversy**: The Television Academy's move to cut five categories from the telecast drew swift condemnation from the DGA, WGA, and SAG-AFTRA ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/dga-wga-sag-aftra-reaction-emmys-cut-categories-telecast-1236997353/)). This is a rare united front from the guilds.
- **Tom Brady Slaps Logan Paul**: Both [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/sports/news/tom-brady-slaps-logan-paul-fanatics-fest-fans-staged-1236815284/) and [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/tom-brady-logan-paul-slap-fanatics-fest-wwe-promo-1236651395/) report the altercation, with the latter confirming Brady earlier teased a WWE villain role, fueling speculation of a scripted crossover.
- **Death of Chef Dom Taylor**: The Netflix 'Five Star Chef' winner died suddenly at 44 ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/chef-dom-taylor-dead-netflix-five-star-chef-winner-1236997413/)), a loss felt across the culinary and streaming communities.
- **Lorde vs. Spotify AI**: Lorde publicly rejected Spotify's new AI feature ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/lorde-calls-out-spotify-ai-about-the-song-feature-1236997350/)), adding to a growing list of artists wary of AI's role in music.

**Signal**: The intersection of sports, WWE, and influencer culture (Brady-Paul) and the guilds' pushback against Emmy changes will likely drive industry conversations into next week.

日韩.zh:
《Agent Kim Reactivated》收视再创新高，宣告SBS动作剧在收官阶段的强大后劲；SEVENTEEN Wonwoo在30岁生日当天发行感性单曲《Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter》，延续了韩流偶像通过生日发行个人作品的惯例。男团成员品牌声誉排名中BTS Jimin继续领跑，而中国BL剧《Deep In》收获韩媒关注，显示中韩内容流通仍在暗流涌动。

- [《Agent Kim Reactivated》刷新周五收视记录](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855515wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-earns-its-highest-friday-ratings-yet)
- [Wonwoo生日单曲发布](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855461wpp/watch-seventeens-wonwoo-marks-his-birthday-with-heartfelt-new-song-spring-summer-fall-winter)
- [七月男团成员品牌声誉排名](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855510wpp/july-boy-group-member-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8)
- [中国BL剧《Deep In》获韩媒首评](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853892wpp/first-impressions-chinese-bl-drama-deep-in-is-about-two-actors-whose-feelings-go-off-script)

韩剧板块在存量竞争中仍能跑出黑马，而偶像生日音乐已成固定粉丝经济颗粒；中韩内容互评的增多值得关注政策层面是否出现松动信号。
日韩.en:
The Korean entertainment desk is buzzing with drama ratings milestones, brand reputation rankings, and idol birthday releases. SBS's 'Agent Kim Reactivated' reached its highest Friday rating ahead of its finale, while SEVENTEEN's Wonwoo dropped a heartfelt birthday song. A new Chinese BL drama 'Deep In' is also gaining attention.

- **'Agent Kim Reactivated' Ratings High**: Episode 7 achieved a new Friday record ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855515wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-earns-its-highest-friday-ratings-yet)), indicating strong momentum for the final two weeks.
- **July Boy Group Brand Reputation**: BTS's Jimin topped the list ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855510wpp/july-boy-group-member-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8)), based on analysis of 755 boy group members from June 18 to July 18.
- **Wonwoo's Birthday Gift**: SEVENTEEN's Wonwoo released 'Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter' on his 30th birthday ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855461wpp/watch-seventeens-wonwoo-marks-his-birthday-with-heartfelt-new-song-spring-summer-fall-winter)), a sentimental track reflecting on seasons spent with fans.
- **'Dream To You' Premiere Reviewed**: The new ENA romantic comedy starring Hyeri and Hwang In Youp received a mixed review highlighting both strengths and weaknesses ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855410wpp/3-things-we-loved-2-things-we-didnt-about-the-premiere-of-dream-to-you)).
- **Chinese BL 'Deep In' Makes First Impression**: The drama about actors blurring lines on set is being watched as a potential breakout in the Chinese BL space ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853892wpp/first-impressions-chinese-bl-drama-deep-in-is-about-two-actors-whose-feelings-go-off-script)).

**Signal**: 'Agent Kim Reactivated' is a strong contender for year-end drama awards, while Wonwoo's solo release may foreshadow further individual projects from SEVENTEEN members.

中国.en:
Chinese entertainment news this day reflects a mix of industry analysis, celebrity business failures, and rising new talent. A feature on Guizhou's role as a 'hidden giant' in film/tv, the financial collapse of boxing champion Zou Shiming's ventures, and a profile of a top actress who debuted at age 4 are among the standout stories. The industry also mourns five entertainers in one week.

- **Guizhou as Film/TV Powerhouse**: An analysis ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE9paGpWNkRET2RhWWZhYzhxOEt5LVpnMVhlVVhpZmxyUENhMWY3SUQzU09LSUkweWlMaXZWSXNWZ25CeFdjV3VVOFZ0cHByTWxGdFVIT3J0Sm1aU0hSeFUwRkNTN2dDRWUwdlc4V1BGTHdDYnJXT0ZGRg)) reveals how the southwestern province has become an unsupported but crucial production hub, shifting perceptions of China's regional film industry.
- **Zou Shiming Loses 200 Million Yuan**: The Olympic boxing gold medalist's failed entrepreneurship is dissected ([Sina News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQNDJzcldvN1p1Z2dFNWhFUVlCY3NyN1FQclhKTE1LdnhTdFlfUDA3dVc5RkcxRjFManJHV3NRZzlEaWRkd05VVl9paXRMUWVBb29oMnNCOGgzZmtoSDhyQzB5dU9iUW5NTzZBQi1kTnZkMGtzVEJlMXMwLWg1RFFZaTZMa3pkS1M4bTE1MVlyY1gtUUVBV2xXQw)), highlighting systemic risks for celebrities entering business.
- **Week of Mourning**: A piece ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTFBHZUttYmhGMmFLVk9IVkxKQmpNdkVjOGV3RmNPWXJ1VDl0Y3dWV3B2NW83RUxzYW9KUUpzYlBldm55R3g4Y2h1N1RXLVVNT3I0bkEwOHNFMC12b2YxWHN5RWhBSmJoZXJXUWc0ZmRLUWxFa045enc)) notes that five entertainers died within seven days, prompting reflection on the public's desensitization to celebrity deaths.
- **Rise of a Longtime Top Actress**: A profile ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9PaklnbVZOTkphTmY4eTBnRUNvcUlKcG9TZUxnWDBEd3VqcEJ2ejA2LXhQb3p4c1RVdUJQaWRFY0MtajdZbVVzejhDaWFFRkU)) traces a 38-year-old star who started at age 4 and has remained at the top for 15 years, offering lessons in longevity.
- **Pregnancy Rumors and Privacy**: The 85花 cohort faces intense public scrutiny over pregnancy rumors ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFBnUmhBcjk0UHFBV1dsUmJvWHh4dk56Z0FVbnZpNHRpbVVrdUJBVHRkQWJSLVlnN2MycWFGanRKZjhoUVJuWmV2bDJJRldTOXc)), raising questions about celebrity privacy in the digital age.

**Signal**: The Zou Shiming case may prompt tighter regulations on celebrity endorsements and business involvement, while the Guizhou industry analysis could influence regional film policy.

微博社区动态.en:
The Weibo community desk is dominated by fan-driven micro-events: idol teasers, small gestures turned viral, and interpersonal dramas among trainee groups. Wang Junkai's self-answered 'anyone there?' post and Zhang Linghe's 52 fire emojis are classic examples of fan-service marketing. Meanwhile, a serious incident involving Zhu Zhixin being verbally abused by anti-fans highlights the dark side of fandom.

- **Wang Junkai's Tease**: The singer posted 'anyone there?' and replied to himself 'WJK is here' ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxObmNDT2p0U2lYVHU2WjNsU2xCLTBKT2ZnV2d3djZTcEFoNm8zeEM5NUhCNmJNRVBMREx5bnhaNDJMb2dkMGhtZXpLNEo5dlhrWDlHaVB5LWZoMllaM2pNYzBPNUgwaXgyc1I5QUhnXzZUdVNveDBLUFVFSzRfbXZBUlNGNGxNUHcteDVUQUkyWFE5RV8xcmlUYTFQR0xWWlhCN0RyY2tB)), promoting a new song drop that delighted fans.
- **Zhang Linghe's 52 Fires**: The actor posted 52 fire emojis ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9pT1A2am1LMkxSaUVUZ0hTNWtSZTJoNk5jNEFXSU5zVTdvLXdEa3VJcGxOUXJpd21xM21CLVNfM0JNVElKeUR5c2QwT0lYcHoyOXBNZndyZ3M2ZV9sYTRKQUxiRkVjd1Vid0FyejI0WmU)), igniting speculation about a new drama announcement.
- **Zhu Zhixin Harassed On-Site**: Reports ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9SX0hob3VQM1gyNl9mNGtwSnRSZFdLXzNYTUFQSXV0Z2tfazVYVkhCYThPZG9HVTFYYkt0RGx1bmp3SDVOTzVJaTQ5TTg4SXdtbUdra0ticUZTcG1FZWZBa25BOVgzRDNCTjhVcTRWZ0k)) detail how trainee Zhu Zhixin was cursed at and reduced to tears by anti-fans, exposing the toxicity in fan communities.
- **Song Yaxuan's Small Action Goes Viral**: A mundane act of threading a loose thread on a variety show drew widespread attention ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFB1V2RWTkNzNExibmlFU05OSER5bFp0QUU2eFdsR3BGM0VVM0hzMlRiV2FFUnZvbXEtZUtZUHMwQ1hQdTVXNk9heUNuY0lIdjM4bDd0YTJGbFl4V1poQnlXWnczQ21FMGt4ZEpkLUpIT3c)), showing how minor gestures become obsessive fan topics.
- **Yu Shuxin on '种地吧'**: Multiple trending topics ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5zRF9xd01lbDNhUWlfMkYydWY1T251TUtmUWs4MVdySDJycGgwSURmY2pSV1NGaGp6dFRGeUxxY3FXa2hMSlkxTUl5NDRXWEhkbU43a1dyeEp1RTB0eTEtQjdoczAxS0F0amRha0VCV3M)) surround Yu Shuxin's appearance on the farming-themed show, reflecting the show's broad appeal.

**Signal**: Weibo's ecosystem is increasingly driven by parasocial interactions; the Zhu Zhixin incident may prompt agencies to better protect trainees from on-site harassment.
